eden.uk.plus1.title: New Zealand: Earth's Mythical Islands - Cast Adrift
eden.uk.plus1.description: Isolated since the time of the dinosaurs, New Zealand's wildlife has been left to its own devices - with surprising consequences. Its ancient forests are still stalked by predators from the Jurassic era. It's also one of the most geologically active countries on Earth. From Kiwis with their giant eggs, to forest-dwelling penguins and helicopter-riding sheep dogs, meet the astonishing creatures and resilient people who must rise to the challenges of their beautiful, dramatic and demanding home. (Documentary, Animals, Miniseries, Nature) - 2016

eden.uk.plus1.title: New Zealand: Earth's Mythical Islands - Wild Extremes
eden.uk.plus1.description: The most extreme and wild parts of New Zealand are in the South Island, which lie towards Antarctica, in the path of the tempestuous `roaring forties'. This is home to some of the most rapidly rising mountains in the world, the Southern Alps. From hyper-intelligent parrots, to sinister snails with teeth and magical constellations of glow-worms, this is the story of New Zealand's wildest places and its most resilient pioneers, all of who must embrace radical solutions to survive. (Documentary, Animals, Miniseries, Nature) - 2016

eden.uk.plus1.title: New Zealand: Earth's Mythical Islands - New Arrivals
eden.uk.plus1.description: New Zealand was one of the last land-masses to be found and settled by people. Lush and fertile, almost everything brought here flourishes, often with surprising consequences. Told through the experiences of its native species - in particular, a charismatic and peculiar giant, flightless parrot - this is the moving story of the changing fortunes of New Zealand's wildlife, since humans first arrived. (Documentary, Animals, Miniseries, Nature) - 2016

eden.uk.plus1.title: Wild Japan - Honshu
eden.uk.plus1.description: The central island of Honshu is home to over 100 million people, but it has a wild heart - most of Honshu is mountainous. This wilderness is home to an astonishing range of wildlife. (Documentary, Animals, Miniseries, Nature) - 2015

Davina McCall and Nicky Campbell present.

E4+1.uk.description: East Kent In east Kent, outspoken estate agent Sean and his girlfriend Beth kick off the competition with a Welsh-themed menu. Day two sees Marcus and Miguel lay on a Malaysian feast, but Sean's teasing of his girlfriend steals the limelight.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S1 E15 Trobiano's Chef Gordon Ramsay visits Trobiano's of Great Neck, N.Y., an Italian restaurant that is a half-million dollars in debt; during a confrontation with the owner about the cleanliness of the kitchen and the quality of the food, Ramsay walks out.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S1 E19 Jack's Waterfront Gordon helps out at Jack's Waterfront in St Clair Shores, Mich., a lakeside restaurant in a popular summer spot.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E3 PJ's Steakhouse Gordon travels to Queens, New York to visit PJ's Steakhouse, a restaurant he quickly discovers is all sizzle and no steak. Owners Joe and Madalyn have found themselves in serious debt after opening the high-end restaurant. The couple were overcome by grief when Joe's brother PJ passed away. Struggling to move on they decided to take over the lease of PJ's bar and turn it into a restaurant.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S2 E14 Bixby's Back It's Valentine's Day and that can only mean one thing, the return of Clive Bixby. Plus, Mitchell's PA proves problematic and Jay and Gloria get competitive.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S2 E15 Princess Party DeDe has come back to town to celebrate Lily's second birthday, and she's brought some baggage from the past with her.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S15 E18 Catch 'Em if You Can When Marge and Homer are caught enjoying a romantic weekend in Miami instead of a boring family visit to Dayton, Bart and Lisa embark on a cross-country journey to hunt them down and ruin their holiday. Grandpa, abandoned in Miami, enjoys the company of gay Miami swinger Raoul.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S15 E19 Simple Simpson Homer becomes an anonymous vigilante, shaming Springfield's miscreants by splatting them with pies, but can Mr Burns blackmail the Pie Man into pieing the Dalai Lama?

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S15 E20 The Way We Weren't Homer and Marge learn they were destined to be together when Homer tells the story of his first kiss.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S15 E21 Bart-Mangled Banner The Simpsons are thrown in prison for high treason after Bart accidentally moons the American flag. Their only hope is an old man with an escape plan.

E4+1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E20 Dungeons and Dragons, Anyone? Adam betrays his friends after becoming captain of the gym class. Erica encounters resistance from Beverly and Murray when she decides she wants to go to college.

E4+1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E21 Rush Beverly smothers Barry when he tells her that she favours Adam. Meanwhile, Murray is not happy about Erica's new boyfriend who is a Rush fanatic.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E11 Lifetime Supply After having a doctor's visit and then missing the call with the test results, Phil automatically jumps to conclusions and starts saying his goodbyes. Meanwhile, Javier pops up unannounced again and takes Manny to the horse races for a belated birthday celebration.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E12 Egg Drop Luke and Manny have a big school project to design the best capsule that would protect an egg in a two-story drop, but when Claire and Jay catch wind of it, their own competitive drives kick in. Meanwhile, Phil solicits the help of Haley and Gloria to sit as plants in the audience during a huge real estate presentation he has put together.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E13 Little Bo Bleep The family helps Claire prepare for her upcoming televised debate with Duane Bailey for the town council seat, but will they do more harm than good? Meanwhile, Lily is going to be a precious flower girl for the first time, but the problem is that she's just discovered her first expletive and Mitch and Cam don't know how best to deal with this new parenting test.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E14 Me? Jealous? Phil is so preoccupied with impressing his new business partner, that he doesn't notice him being overtly inappropriate with Claire. Meanwhile, four is a crowd at Jay and Gloria's.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S27 E17 The Burns Cage Homer makes it his mission to find Smithers a boyfriend and signs him up to a dating app. Meanwhile, Bart messes with the school's stage show.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S27 E18 How Lisa Got Her Marge Back Inside a giant factory in Guangdong Province, China, a child works tirelessly applying stickers to a practical joke novelty toy called Money Grabber. The toy eventually ends up in Bart's possession.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S27 E19 Fland Canyon One night, Homer sings to Maggie, hoping the sound of his voice will lull her to sleep. When that fails, Maggie shows her father a board book containing the story Little Red Riding Hood. Homer has read the book aloud many times, so he decides to tell the baby a different tale.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S27 E20 To Courier with Love Homer makes a deal with a travel agent to be the courier of a top-secret briefcase to get a discount on a family holiday to Paris.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S20 E21 Coming to Homerica An outbreak of food poisoning at Krusty's restaurant chain is traced back to tainted barley in nearby Ogdenville, settled years earlier by Norwegian immigrants. Ogdenville Barley Mills is promptly shut down and Springfield finds itself swamped by the unemployed.

E4+1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4+1.uk.description: S2 E12 Beach House Jake ruins a detectives-only getaway to Charles' beach house by inviting Holt. Charles helps Rosa be romantic with her new boyfriend, and Gina tries to get Amy drunk.

E4+1.uk.title: First Dates
E4+1.uk.description: S12 E7 Episode 7 61-year-old Italian restaurant owner Giovanni thinks he can give Fred a run for his money on the charm front. And Jason has to try and see past Tyrone's ADHD for a successful date.

E4+1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4+1.uk.description: S20 E5 Episode 5 Britain's sharpest armchair critics have been watching 'Bad Sisters', 'Nadiya's Everyday Baking', 'The Kardashians', 'Super/Natural', 'A Trip to Infinity', BBC News (energy cap), and BBC News (Kwasi U-turn).

E4+1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4+1.uk.description: S20 E6 Episode 6 Britain's sharpest armchair critics have been watching 'Strictly Come Dancing', 'First Dates Hotel', 'My Possessed Pet', 'This Morning', 'The Ex-Wife', 'Sue Perkins: Perfectly Legal' and ITV News (power shortages).

E4+1.uk.title: Naked Attraction
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E3 Jamie & Jasmine Edinburgh musician Jamie is tired of the life of groupies and flings and seeks a deeper connection. Jasmin from Bognor has ME, a chronic fatigue illness, and needs acceptance from a new lover.

E4+1.uk.title: First Dates
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E2 Episode 2 Self-proclaimed ladies' man Jayden gets smitten with Isabel, but he doesn't want to reveal his Don Juan ways. 44-year-old Sarah, who is deaf, has a date with estate agent John, and eternal romantic Tim returns to the restaurant.

E4+1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4+1.uk.description: S20 E4 Episode 4 Britain's sharpest armchair critics have been watching 'Strictly Come Dancing', 'Coronation Street', 'Antiques Roadshow', 'Frozen Planet II', 'Kings of Pain', 'Help! My House Is Haunted', 'Only Connect', and ITV News on the mini-budget.

E4+1.uk.title: Below Deck Down Under
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E4 Kiss and Don't Tell Anthony puts Tzarina in a bind, causing her to crack under pressure. Harry's future on the Katina is in doubt as he struggles with an injury. Marina asks Wihan on a date, sparking tension between her and Tzarina.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S1 E14 Giuseppe's Gordon Ramsay visits Giuseppe's, a family-run Italian restaurant in Macomb Township, Mich., that has a chaotic atmosphere in the kitchen and a lack of clientele; to spread word about the restaurant, Giuseppe's hosts a bowl-a-thon.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E3 PJ's Steakhouse Gordon travels to Queens, New York to visit PJ's Steakhouse, a restaurant he quickly discovers is all sizzle and no steak. Owners Joe and Madalyn have found themselves in serious debt after opening the high-end restaurant. The couple were overcome by grief when Joe's brother PJ passed away. Struggling to move on they decided to take over the lease of PJ's bar and turn it into a restaurant.

E4+1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4+1.uk.description: S10 E5 Uncle-ing With her due date approaching, Erica is over pregnancy and demands a babymoon; Adam and Barry seek out advice on being an uncle from some unexpected sources.

E4+1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4+1.uk.description: S10 E6 DKNY Geoff's terror over Beverly controlling all baby-care duties turns into a jump-scare-filled comedic thriller; Adam is excited to spend Halloween visiting Dave Kim at NYU, but his feelings change when he discovers his friend has reinvented himself.

E4+1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4+1.uk.description: S2 E12 Beach House Jake ruins a detectives-only getaway to Charles' beach house by inviting Holt. Charles helps Rosa be romantic with her new boyfriend, and Gina tries to get Amy drunk.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S5 E15 The Feud The feud between Phil and Gil Thorpe reaches a new level. A lice outbreak hits the family. Haley and Alex are trapped in the basement by a possum, and Manny and Gloria are embarrassed during a school field trip.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S5 E16 Spring-a-Ding-Fling While Cam's thunder is stolen by a popular teacher's return, Mitch doesn't know what to make of his former college pal-turned-new boss.

E4+1.uk.title: Rude(ish) Tube
E4+1.uk.description: Shorts A short clip from Rude Tube's incredibly naughty little sister Rude-ish Tube, featuring food and animals.

E4+1.uk.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
E4+1.uk.description: Kent In East Kent, dinner party veterans Mike and Helenor kick off the competition, followed by Rob and Jade on day two who put together a Thai-inspired menu, and the last to host are visually impaired Caroline and her easy-going husband Tony.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S1 E18 Hannah & Mason's Chef Ramsay heads to Cranbury, N.J., to help two friends who bought a French Bistro they used to work in. A disgusting discovery in a kitchen cooler forces Ramsay to shut the restaurant down on the busiest night of the year.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S1 E16 Black Pearl Manhattan's Black Pearl, a struggling seafood restaurant with three different owners running the kitchen, has come to chef Gordon Ramsay for help; one of the owners is resistant to change and questions every move Gordon makes.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S2 E11 Fleming Gordon visits Fleming, a Danish restaurant in Miami, Florida. It was once the best family-run restaurant in town, but now the place is on its last legs. Fleming was bought by husband and wife team Andy and Suzanne eight years ago, in the hope of continuing the restaurant's past success, but with no clue about Danish cuisine it's no real surprise the place is losing money. Can Gordon save their bacon?

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S2 E18 Boys' Night Jay accidentally gatecrashes Mitch and Cam's evening out, and Luke befriends his crotchety old neighbour.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S2 E19 The Musical Man Cam accepts the role of music director at Luke and Manny's school, but his enthusiasm is far from infectious. Meanwhile, Jay's brother Donnie is in town.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S15 E22 Fraudcast News When Mr Burns buys up all the media outlets in Springfield in an attempt to polish his image, Lisa starts her own newspaper.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S27 E1 Every Man's Dream After learning, he has narcolepsy, Homer gets drunk instead of going home with his medicine; a visit to a marriage counsellor leads to a trial separation for Homer and Marge; Homer dates a woman in her 20s.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S27 E2 Cue Detective Bart and Lisa are on the case when someone steals the smoker Homer bought from a mysterious man at a barbecue shack.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S27 E3 Puffless Twins Selma and Patti agree to give up smoking, but when Selma relapses after just 10 minutes, Patti moves in with Homer and Marge.

E4+1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E22 Smother's Day When Beverly receives last-minute mum coupons for Mother's Day, she feels upset. Elsewhere, Adam wants to go to space camp.

E4+1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E23 Big Orange Barry's favourite shirt is hated by both his mother Beverly and his girlfriend Lainey, so they hatch a plan together to destroy it. But once the shirt goes missing, Barry asks Adam and Erica to investigate.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E15 Aunt Mommy After closing on the sale of a house to Mitch and Cam's friends, Phil and Claire take the two of them out for a celebratory dinner where they proceed to over-indulge in drinks, which leads to some over-sharing, and finally results in waking up the next morning hung over and begging the question - if you'll do anything for family, shouldn't there still be a line drawn somewhere?

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E16 Virgin Territory Phil realises that his little girl is growing up when he overhears something he wishes he hadn't about Haley. Meanwhile, Jay's ego takes a bruising.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E17 Leap Day With Cam's birthday falling but once every four years, the pressure is on Mitch to do something special. Emotions are running high over at the Dunphys' too.

E4+1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E18 Send Out the Clowns Cameron reunites an old clown act despite Mitchell's warnings. Phil plays hardball with a rival to get a listing. Manny's new friend has a crush on Gloria. Claire wants her daughters to befriend her on Facebook.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S27 E21 Simprovised After butchering a speech in front of all of his friends at work, Homer turns to improvisational comedy to gain back his confidence.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S27 E22 Orange Is the New Yellow A jail sentence serves as a welcome break for Marge from her hectic life. In her absence, Homer struggles to hold down the fort.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S21 E1 Homer the Whopper Homer ends up with a superhero's physique after he is chosen to appear in a film based on a character created by Comic Book Guy.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S21 E2 Bart Gets a Z Principal Skinner fires Mrs Krabappel after she makes a drunken fool of herself at the elementary school, but Skinner doesn't know that Bart spiked her coffee with alcohol.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S8 E2 You Only Move Twice Homer accepts a new job and moves the family to Cypress Creek, where the perfect setting soon turns sour.

E4+1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4+1.uk.description: S2 E13 Payback The squad members demand that Jake repay all the money he has borrowed over the years, and Holt and Amy re-open a case.

E4+1.uk.title: Free Guy
E4+1.uk.description: A bank teller called Guy realises he is a background character in an open world video game called Free City that will soon go offline.

E4+1.uk.title: Naked Attraction
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E4 Millie & Alex Having exhausted Cornwall's dating pool, Millie hopes to finally wave goodbye to laid-back surfers. And Alex the window cleaner seeks someone who'll take a shine to his fit body.

E4+1.uk.title: Naked Attraction
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E5 Katie & James Self-confessed 'dating disaster' Katie, from Bristol, is looking to turn her luck around. Also, student James has a thing for heels and glitter and hopes to meet an open-minded guy.

E4+1.uk.title: First Dates
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E3 Episode 3 Security guard AJ is looking for 'a firm woman' and tries to impress a podium dancer Paige. Kitchen designer Kerry has a date with a fellow northerner Ryan who is trying to laugh her into bed, and software designer Mark faces spiritual Sophia.

E4+1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4+1.uk.description: S20 E7 Episode 7 Britain's sharpest armchair critics have been watching: 'I Can See Your Voice', 'Emmerdale', 'Strictly Come Dancing', 'Unbreakable', 'The Ex-Wife', 'Bargain Hunt', and BBC/ITV News (new Chancellor).

E4+1.uk.title: Below Deck Down Under
E4+1.uk.description: S3 E5 Submergency Wihan's attention shifts to a new flame while Lara gets frustrated with his carefree attitude. An overlooked hazard causes Johnny and a charter guest to flip a jet ski in dangerously shallow waters, sending the deck team into a frenzied panic.

E4+1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4+1.uk.description: S1 E13 Handlebar Gordon Ramsay pays a visit to the Handlebar Restaurant and Lounge in Mount Sinai, New York, where the owners are in denial about its outdated decor and the head chef's lack of passion.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S8 E3 The Homer They Fall Homer turns to a career in pro boxing when he discovers he has a genetic condition that protects his brain from injury.

E4+1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4+1.uk.description: S10 E7 Rhinestones and Roses The country music craze hits the town and everyone is line dancing; Adam scores a new job, but his lack of time to spend with Pop-Pop results in some comically disastrous outcomes.

E4+1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4+1.uk.description: S10 E8 Another Turkey in the Trot Geoff and Erica are stressed over the new baby; an unexpected Goldberg relative arrives for Thanksgiving, making everyone highly suspicious.

E4+1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4+1.uk.description: S2 E13 Payback The squad members demand that Jake repay all the money he has borrowed over the years, and Holt and Amy re-open a case.

E4+1.uk.title: LEGO Masters: Grand Masters of the Galaxy
E4+1.uk.description: S7 E9 Movie Magic Hold on to your bricks! The five remaining teams race to the semi-final as they create Hollywood-worthy car scenes with hyperrealistic brick rides.

E4+1.uk.title: Don't Tell the Bride
E4+1.uk.description: S12 E14 The One with All the Pranks Maria is a perfectionist, placing her dream of a country house wedding in the hands of her fiancé Sam. However, Sam loves a good prank.

talkingpictures.uk.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
talkingpictures.uk.description: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout October. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: No Trace
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1950. Drama. Directed by John Gilling. Writer Robert Southley finds his lifestyle threatened by blackmail from a former US criminal associate. Stars Hugh Sinclair, Dinah Sheridan & John Laurie. (Drama, Movie) - 2021

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Crooked Sky
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1957. Crime drama directed by Henry Cass. An American detective & Scotland Yard must work together to crack a counterfeit gang. Stars Wayne Morris, Karin Booth and Anton Diffring. (Drama, Movie) - 1957

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Spider and the Fly
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1949. Crime. Directed by Robert Hamer. Stars Eric Portman, Nadia Gray & George Cole. An unusual love triangle develops between two criminals and a policeman on the eve of the first World War. (Animation, Comedy, Movie) - 1931

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Duchess of Duke Street
talkingpictures.uk.description: Trouble and Strife. 1976. Stars Gemma Jones, John Cater & Maureen O'Brien. A woman from Starr's past, down on her luck, begs him to use his influence to obtain a job for her at the Bentinck. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: High Tide
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1980. Thriller. A man just released from prison for manslaughter heads to the West Country to solve the mystery behind his victim's cryptic last words. Stars Ian McShane, Wendy Morgan & John Bird. (Drama, Romance, Movie) - 2024

talkingpictures.uk.title: Look At Life Any Old Iron
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1962. A look at the people who prepare salvaged steel to be re-used, also with a glimpse at the steel foundries which melt it all down again. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Julius Hagen Season
talkingpictures.uk.description: Join Noel as he introduces the delightful musical comedy Squibs from 1935, and provides an insight into Julius Hagen's part in making the film. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Squibs
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1935. Comedy. Directed by Henry Edwards. Stars Betty Balfour. A cockney flowerseller, Squibs with a father overwhelmed by gambling debts wins through with the help of assorted friends. (Movie) - 1935

talkingpictures.uk.title: Julius Hagen Season
talkingpictures.uk.description: Tune in to find out which brilliant Julius Hagen film will be shown next week. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Strange But True?
talkingpictures.uk.description: Bigfoot/Ouija Boards. 1997. Michael Aspel speaks to Todd Neiss about his apparent bigfoot sighting and are Ouija boards just a bit of fun or more dangerous than we know. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Brothers
talkingpictures.uk.description: Loneliness. 1974. Stars Richard Easton, Hilary Tindall & Rio Fanning. Brian and Ann both face the problems of loneliness. Meanwhile, the Hammonds are invited to Sir Neville's for a shooting party. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Mark Saber
talkingpictures.uk.description: Luger For Chesser. 1957. Stars Donald Gray, Sarah Lawson & Gladys Boot. A man with no friends or enemies is killed. The finger of suspicion points at his ex-wife who has come into his money. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1975. Roger Whittaker and Saffron perform 'New World In The Morning', 'The Seasons Come and the Seasons Go', and Helen Shapiro performs 'Lean On Me'. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Killing Of Sister George
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1968. Drama. Directed by Robert Aldrich. Stars Beryl Reid, Susannah York, Coral Browne, Patricia Medina & Ronald Fraser. An aging actress faces the loss of her popular television role. (Comedy, Drama, Movie) - 1968

talkingpictures.uk.title: Love and Pain and the Whole Damn Thing
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1973. Comedy. Directed by Alan J. Pakula. Stars Maggie Smith, Timothy Bottoms & May Heatherly. A prim English spinster meets a college drop-out while on a bus trip through Spain. (Comedy, Drama, Romance, Movie) - 1973

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Madame Gambles
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1951. Comedy. The owner of a dress shop gambles the shop away to her bookie who inherits, not only the shop, but the manager. Directed by Maclean Rogers. Starring Richard Hearne and Petula Clark. (Comedy, Movie) - 1951

talkingpictures.uk.title: Burke's Law
talkingpictures.uk.description: Who Killed Super Sleuth? 1964. Stars Gene Barry, Gary Conway & Regis Toomey. Four world renowned cops and a US private eye become suspect in another sleuth's murder. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman
talkingpictures.uk.description: Fine Feathered Finks. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burgess Meredith & Lewis Charles. Disguised as Bruce Wayne, Batman infiltrates the Penguin's umbrella factory in an attempt to track him down. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Penguin's a Jinx. 1966. Stars Adam West, Lewis Charles & Burgess Meredith. Narrowly escaping a fiery death, Batman and Robin figure out the Penguin's next move is to kidnap a famous actress. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Sherlock Holmes - The Case of the Thistle Killer. 1954. Starring
talkingpictures.uk.description: Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Archie Duncan. Sherlock helps hunt down a killer of women who leaves three thistles next to each body. (Entertainment)

amc.us.title: The Conjuring
amc.us.description: In 1970, paranormal investigators and demonologists Lorraine (Vera Farmiga) and Ed (Patrick Wilson) Warren are summoned to the home of Carolyn (Lili Taylor) and Roger (Ron Livingston) Perron. The Perrons and their five daughters have recently moved into a secluded farmhouse, where a supernatural presence has made itself known. Though the manifestations are relatively benign at first, events soon escalate in horrifying fashion, especially after the Warrens discover the house's macabre history. (Horror, Thriller) - 2013

amc.us.title: The Haunting in Connecticut
amc.us.description: When their son Matt (Kyle Gallner) receives a diagnosis of cancer, Sara (Virginia Madsen) and Peter (Martin Donovan) Campbell move to Connecticut to be closer to his doctors. At first all is well, but then Matt becomes increasingly disturbed by what appears to be paranormal activity. Sara turns to a priest for help, and the ghosts are seemingly banished -- but Matt's condition takes a sudden and unexplained turn for the worse, and the lives of Sara and the rest of her family are endangered. (Horror, Thriller) - 2009

amc.us.title: Poltergeist
amc.us.description: Strange and creepy happenings beset an average California family, the Freelings -- Steve (Craig T. Nelson), Diane (JoBeth Williams), teenaged Dana (Dominique Dunne), eight-year-old Robbie (Oliver Robins), and five-year-old Carol Ann (Heather O'Rourke) -- when ghosts commune with them through the television set. Initially friendly and playful, the spirits turn unexpectedly menacing, and, when Carol Ann goes missing, Steve and Diane turn to a parapsychologist and eventually an exorcist for help. (Horror, Thriller) - 1982

amc.us.title: Halloween 4: The Return of Michael Myers
amc.us.description: The apparently comatose Michael Myers (George P. Wilbur) is being transferred from one hospital to another, but he wakes up when the ambulance crew talk about his surviving niece, Jamie (Danielle Harris). After slaughtering his attendants, Myers sets out to find his one living relative who is, fortunately, being cared for by a kind and resourceful foster sister named Rachel (Ellie Cornell). Meanwhile, the ever-cautious Dr. Loomis (Donald Pleasence) remains on the killer's path. (Holiday, Horror) - 1988

amc.us.title: Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers
amc.us.description: After lying in a coma for a year, Michael Myers (Donald L. Shanks) awakens and stalks his way back to his small hometown in Illinois, intent on killing his niece, Jamie (Danielle Harris), who has been confined to a mental institution since Michael's last attempt to slay her. Suspecting a psychic link between Michael and Jamie, psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence) joins forces with Sheriff Ben Meeker (Beau Starr) and attempts to stop Michael's latest rampage. (Holiday, Horror) - 1989

amc.us.title: Halloween II
amc.us.description: A year after narrowly escaping death at the hands of Michael Myers (Tyler Mane), Laurie Strode is at the breaking point, pushed to the edge by Dr. Loomis' (Malcolm McDowell) revelation that she's Michael's sister. Little does she know, the unstoppable killer is back in Haddonfield and, driven by visions of their dead mother (Sheri Moon Zombie), he is determined to bring about a bloody family reunion. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 2009

amc.us.title: Halloween
amc.us.description: Nearly two decades after being committed to a mental institution for killing his stepfather and older sister, Michael Myers breaks out, intent on returning to the town of Haddonfield, Ill. He arrives in his hometown on Halloween with the indomitable purpose of hunting down his younger sister, Laurie. The only thing standing between Michael and a Halloween night of bloody carnage is psychologist Dr. Samuel Loomis. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 2007

amc.us.title: Ghost Ship
amc.us.description: In a remote region of the Bering Sea, a boat salvage crew discovers the eerie remains of a grand passenger liner thought lost for more than 40 years. But once onboard the eerie, cavernous ship, the crew of the Arctic Warrior discovers that the decaying vessel is anything but deserted. It's home to something more deadly and horrific than anything they've encountered in all their years at sea. (Horror, Thriller) - 2002

amc.us.title: Friday the 13th
amc.us.description: Against the advice of locals and police, Clay (Jared Padalecki) scours the eerie woods surrounding Crystal Lake for his missing sister. But the rotting cabins of an abandoned summer camp are not the only things he finds. Hockey-masked killer Jason Voorhees lies in wait for a chance to use his razor-sharp machete on Clay and the group of college students who have come to the forest to party. (Horror, Thriller) - 2009

amc.us.title: Friday the 13th: The Final Chapter
amc.us.description: A carefree lakeside vacation is interrupted by the re-emergence of killer Jason Voorhees (Ted White). After he escapes from a morgue, leaving bodies in his wake, Jason travels to Camp Crystal Lake where a group of friends is staying. The teens meet some locals: Tommy (Corey Feldman) and Trish (Kimberly Beck), as well as secretive hiker Rob (Erich Anderson). As the group of teenagers engages in drunken debauchery, their numbers begin to dwindle, and pieces of the past resurface. (Horror, Crime drama, Action, Mystery, Thriller) - 1984

amc.us.title: Jason Goes to Hell: The Final Friday
amc.us.description: After being blown away by a team of FBI agents, Jason Voorhees (Kane Hodder) needs to find a way to overcome certain death. When his bloodied remains are sent to the morgue, his heart, still intact, is able to hypnotize a coroner and take over his body. After brutally dispatching a couple of FBI agents, he heads back to his favorite stomping grounds: Crystal Lake. Jason commences another teen massacre while a bounty hunter (Steven Williams) discovers the only way to kill him. (Horror) - 1993

amc.us.title: Friday the 13th Part VIII: Jason Takes Manhattan
amc.us.description: Mass murderer Jason Voorhees (Kane Hodder) is resurrected from the bottom of Crystal Lake. After he kills a passing boat's occupants, he stows away on a cruise ship filled with a high-school graduating class bound for New York City. Biology teacher Charles McCulloch (Peter Mark Richman) is on board with his niece, Rennie (Jensen Daggett), who has visions of Jason drowning as a child. They escape his bloody shipboard rampage, but, when Rennie and Charles reach Manhattan, Jason is close by. (Horror, Action, Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1989

amc.us.title: Friday the 13th, Part VI: Jason Lives
amc.us.description: Years ago, Tommy Jarvis (Thom Mathews) killed infamous hockey-masked murderer Jason Voorhees (C.J. Graham), and the intensity of the experience has landed him in a mental institution. To end his torment and achieve a level of closure, Tommy escapes from the hospital and heads to the graveyard where Jason is buried, intending to dig up the body and cremate it. But, before this total annihilation can occur, a freak electrical accident resurrects Jason from the dead, and the terror begins anew. (Horror, Crime drama, Action, Mystery, Thriller) - 1986

amc.us.title: Friday the 13th: Part 7: The New Blood
amc.us.description: Years after the strange drowning death of her father, Tina Shepard (Lar Park Lincoln) returns to the site of his demise, Crystal Lake. Her developing psychic powers were responsible for ending his life, leaving Tina riddled with guilt as an adult. While deceitful Dr. Crews (Terry Kiser) tries to manipulate her abilities for his own ends, both physician and patient are in for a shock when Tina's powers unwittingly free camper-killer Jason Voorhees from his watery slumber. (Horror, Action, Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 1988

amc.us.title: Friday the 13th
amc.us.description: Crystal Lake's history of murder doesn't deter counselors from setting up a summer camp in the woodsy area. Superstitious locals warn against it, but the fresh-faced young people -- Jack (Kevin Bacon), Alice (Adrienne King), Bill (Harry Crosby), Marcie (Jeannine Taylor) and Ned (Mark Nelson) -- pay little heed to the old-timers. Then they find themselves stalked by a brutal killer. As they're slashed, shot and stabbed, the counselors struggle to stay alive against a merciless opponent. (Horror) - 1980

amc.us.title: Friday the 13th, Part 2
amc.us.description: The second entry in the long-running horror series focuses on a group of teenage would-be counselors converging on Camp Crystal Lake for training under the tutelage of head counselor Paul (John Furey). Inevitably, Paul relates the story of Jason Voorhees (Warrington Gillette), a boy who ostensibly drowned at the camp and whose mother murdered a group of counselors in revenge. No one takes the tale seriously until a very much alive Jason begins gruesomely eliminating people. (Horror, Action, Mystery, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1981

amc.us.title: Friday the 13th - Part III
amc.us.description: The third installment in the "Friday the 13th" series picks up on the day after the carnage with homicidal maniac Jason Voorhees (Richard Brooker) stealing some clothes and killing a local store owner. Meanwhile, Chris (Dana Kimmell) and her sometimes boyfriend, Rick (Paul Kratka), are hosting a group of teenage friends at Chris' lake house. Despite a run-in with a local biker gang, they enjoy an amiable weekend together -- that is, until Jason begins knocking off kids and bikers alike. (Horror, Action, Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 1982

dablnetworkllc.us.title: Hot Bench
dablnetworkllc.us.description: Many popular court shows are on TV. How can the genre improve? How about using a three-judge panel? That's the concept of "Hot Bench," created by Judge Judy Sheindlin. After hearing each case, the judges discuss it among themselves before rendering a verdict. The show's title comes from a term describing a court action in which a judge frequently interrupts lawyers with questions. (Reality, Law) - 2014-09-15

mlbnetwork.us.title: MLB Central
mlbnetwork.us.description: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." (Baseball) - 2015-04-06

mlbnetwork.us.title: Intentional Talk ᴸᶦᵛᵉ

He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media. From crimes like doping in sports to more serious offenses like murder, the series exposes what is really going on in each case. Exposing corruption across the United States is the goal of the series. Cases featured in the half-hour episodes include an ATM heist that resulted in nearly $45 million being stolen worldwide and the former Detroit Mayor Kwame Kilpatrick. (Crime, Drama) - 2015-09-07

fx.us.title: Poltergeist
fx.us.description: All seems well for Eric Bowen (Sam Rockwell), wife Amy (Rosemarie DeWitt) and their three children as they move into their new house in the suburbs of Illinois. Soon, the youngest daughter Maddy (Kennedi Clements) begins talking to an imaginary friend, or so the family thinks. It's not long before sinister spirits wreak havoc in the home, holding Maddy captive and forcing the parents to consult a team of parapsychologists who engage the supernatural entities in a battle for the girl's freedom. (Horror, Thriller) - 2015

fx.us.title: Alien 3
fx.us.description: Ellen Ripley (Sigourney Weaver) is the only survivor when she crash lands on Fiorina 161, a bleak wasteland inhabited by former inmates of the planet's maximum security prison. Once again, Ripley must face skepticism and the alien as it hunts down the prisoners and guards. Without weapons or modern technology of any kind, Ripley leads the men into battle against the terrifying creature. (Science fiction, Horror) - 1992

fx.us.title: Aliens vs. Predator: Requiem
fx.us.description: Residents (Steven Pasquale, Reiko Aylesworth, John Ortiz) of Gunnison, Colorado, are caught up in the crossfire when two deadly extraterrestrial species bring their longstanding conflict to Earth. On the one side, nearly indestructible Aliens; on the other, a lone Predator whose mission is to wipe out all traces of the Alien infestation from Earth, no matter who gets in the way. (Science fiction, Horror, Thriller, Action) - 2007

fx.us.title: The Sixth Sense
fx.us.description: Young Cole Sear (Haley Joel Osment) is haunted by a dark secret: he is visited by ghosts. Cole is frightened by visitations from those with unresolved problems who appear from the shadows. He is too afraid to tell anyone about his anguish, except child psychologist Dr. Malcolm Crowe (Bruce Willis). As Dr. Crowe tries to uncover the truth about Cole's supernatural abilities, the consequences for client and therapist are a jolt that awakens them both to something unexplainable. (Thriller, Mystery, Action, Horror) - 1999

fx.us.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
fx.us.description: Eddie Brock is still struggling to coexist with the shape-shifting extraterrestrial Venom. When deranged serial killer Cletus Kasady also becomes host to an alien symbiote, Brock and Venom must put aside their differences to stop his reign of terror. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction, Comedy) - 2021

fx.us.title: Ghostbusters
fx.us.description: Paranormal researcher Abby Yates and physicist Erin Gilbert are trying to prove that ghosts exist in modern society. When strange apparitions appear in Manhattan, Gilbert and Yates turn to engineer Jillian Holtzmann for help. Also joining the team is Patty Tolan, a lifelong New Yorker who knows the city inside and out. Armed with proton packs and plenty of attitude, the four women prepare for an epic battle as more than 1,000 mischievous ghouls descend on Times Square. (Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure, Action) - 2016

fx.us.title: Star Wars: The Phantom Menace
fx.us.description: Obi-Wan Kenobi (Ewan McGregor) is a young apprentice Jedi knight under the tutelage of Qui-Gon Jinn (Liam Neeson) ; Anakin Skywalker (Jake Lloyd), who will later father Luke Skywalker and become known as Darth Vader, is just a 9-year-old boy. When the Trade Federation cuts off all routes to the planet Naboo, Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan are assigned to settle the matter. (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 1999

fx.us.title: Star Wars: Attack of the Clones
fx.us.description: Set ten years after the events of "The Phantom Menace," the Republic continues to be mired in strife and chaos. A separatist movement encompassing hundreds of planets and powerful corporate alliances poses new threats to the galaxy that even the Jedi cannot stem. These moves, long planned by an as yet unrevealed and powerful force, lead to the beginning of the Clone Wars -- and the beginning of the end of the Republic. (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2002

fx.us.title: Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith
fx.us.description: It has been three years since the Clone Wars began. Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi (Ewan McGregor) and Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker (Hayden Christensen) rescue Chancellor Palpatine (Ian McDiarmid) from General Grievous, the commander of the droid armies, but Grievous escapes. Suspicions are raised within the Jedi Council concerning Chancellor Palpatine, with whom Anakin has formed a bond. Asked to spy on the chancellor, and full of bitterness toward the Jedi Council, Anakin embraces the Dark Side. (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2005

fx.us.title: Star Wars: A New Hope
fx.us.description: The Imperial Forces -- under orders from cruel Darth Vader (David Prowse) -- hold Princess Leia (Carrie Fisher) hostage, in their efforts to quell the rebellion against the Galactic Empire. Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill) and Han Solo (Harrison Ford), captain of the Millennium Falcon, work together with the companionable droid duo R2-D2 (Kenny Baker) and C-3PO (Anthony Daniels) to rescue the beautiful princess, help the Rebel Alliance, and restore freedom and justice to the Galaxy. (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 1977

fx.us.title: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
fx.us.description: The adventure continues in this "Star Wars" sequel. Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill), Han Solo (Harrison Ford), Princess Leia (Carrie Fisher) and Chewbacca (Peter Mayhew) face attack by the Imperial forces and its AT-AT walkers on the ice planet Hoth. While Han and Leia escape in the Millennium Falcon, Luke travels to Dagobah in search of Yoda. Only with the Jedi master's help will Luke survive when the dark side of the Force beckons him into the ultimate duel with Darth Vader (David Prowse). (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 1980

fx.us.title: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
fx.us.description: Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill) battles horrible Jabba the Hutt and cruel Darth Vader to save his comrades in the Rebel Alliance and triumph over the Galactic Empire. Han Solo (Harrison Ford) and Princess Leia (Carrie Fisher) reaffirm their love and team with Chewbacca, Lando Calrissian (Billy Dee Williams), the Ewoks and the androids C-3PO and R2-D2 to aid in the disruption of the Dark Side and the defeat of the evil emperor. (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 1983

fx.us.title: The Mummy
fx.us.description: Nick Morton is a soldier of fortune who plunders ancient sites for timeless artifacts and sells them to the highest bidder. When Nick and his partner come under attack in the Middle East, the ensuing battle accidentally unearths Ahmanet, a betrayed Egyptian princess who was entombed under the desert for thousands of years. With her powers constantly evolving, Morton must now stop the resurrected monster as she embarks on a furious rampage through the streets of London. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Horror, Drama) - 2017

673498.title: Major Dundee
673498.description: During the end of the Civil War, Major Dundee guards Confederate prisoners, Union deserters and ordinary hard-bitten criminals in a remote fort. When Apaches attack the fort and make off with three children, Dundee must set up a posse including Confederates, who face a choice between joining up or being shot. The feud between Dundee and Tyreen is also heated up by a sultry Mexican widow.

673498.title: Western Code
673498.description: Tim Barrett, a renowned lawman, rescues Patty from a ruffian and saves her brother from being lynched.

673498.title: Gun Fury
673498.description: California-bound rancher Ben Warren (Rock Hudson) is shot and left for dead when a demented ex-Confederate, Frank Slayton (Phil Carey), kidnaps his Southern bride-to-be (Donna Reed). Revived, Ben sets out to rescue her. Along the way, he picks up Jess Burgess (Leo Gordon), a slighted former member of Slayton's gang, and American Indian local Johash (Pat Hogan), who has his own beef with the outlaws. Together they embark on a perilous chase toward the Mexican border to stop Slayton.

673498.title: Fighting Fool
673498.description: A sheriff (Tim McCoy) flirts with a local girl (Marceline Day) and chases an outlaw called the Shadow.

673498.title: The Tall T
673498.description: The victims must outsmart their cruel captors after an outlaw, and his gang kidnap an heiress, her nervous husband, and a rancher.

673498.title: Coroner Creek
673498.description: A gunfighter (Randolph Scott) loses his beloved in a robbery and hunts the man (George Macready) to blame, who is living off the loot.

673498.title: Apache Ambush
673498.description: On a cattle drive to Kansas after the Civil War, an ex-Union soldier comes up against Apache and Confederate renegades.

673498.title: The Mountain Men
673498.description: Two old-time Wyoming fur trappers (Charlton Heston, Brian Keith) try to protect a runaway Indian (Victoria Racimo) from her angry ex-mate.

673498.title: End of the Trail
673498.description: An Indian sympathizer accused of running guns to the Arapaho is court-martialed by the man who framed him.

673498.title: Daring Danger
673498.description: A wounded cowboy (Tim McCoy) catches rustlers who use a trick branding iron.

673498.title: The Quick Gun
673498.description: A banished gunfighter (Audie Murphy) returns to his sweetheart (Merry Anders) and helps his sheriff friend (James Best) face outlaws.

673498.title: Gunmen From Laredo
673498.description: A framed Texas rancher (Robert Knapp) escapes from prison for a showdown with a saloonkeeper (Walter Coy).

673500.title: The Bitter Tea of General Yen
673500.description: After arriving in Shanghai in the middle of a revolution, an engaged American missionary is captured and slowly seduced by an infamous warlord.

673500.title: Pushover
673500.description: To get the lowdown on stolen cash, a duty-bound cop makes a move on the girlfriend of a murderous bank robber and accidentally falls for her.

673500.title: Ten Cents a Dance
673500.description: Barbara O'Neill (Barbara Stanwyck) is a poor dance hall girl who catches the eye of the wealthy Bradley Carlton (Ricardo Cortez). However, Barbara has feelings for her neighbor Eddie Miller (Monroe Owsley). After Eddie proposes to her, she says yes, and even secures a job for him from Bradley. Soon, though, Eddie has racked up deep gambling debts and even been unfaithful. Barbara continues to support him, but after he lashes out in jealousy she thinks maybe she should have chosen Bradley.

673500.title: The Doctor Takes a Wife
673500.description: A writer (Loretta Young) and a neurologist (Ray Milland) accept rumors of their marriage when each stands to gain from the mistake.

673500.title: Bonjour tristesse
673500.description: At the height of summer, 18-year-old Cécile is relaxing by the French seaside with her father and falling in love with her new boyfriend. However, the arrival of her late mother's enigmatic friend soon turns her world upside down.

673500.title: Operation Mad Ball
673500.description: A group of enlisted men, led by Private Hogan, are tasked with planning a dance party, while trying to keep it a secret from a busy-body officer.

673500.title: The Cockleshell Heroes
673500.description: During World War II, feuding leaders train British recruits for a risky covert mission to blow up a giant battleship in an enemy-held French port.

673500.title: The Fuller Brush Man
673500.description: Clumsy sanitation worker Red Jones (Red Skelton) is fired from his street-cleaning job shortly after his girlfriend, Ann Elliot (Janet Blair), refuses his marriage proposal until he betters himself. While training to become a door-to-door salesman, he accidentally stumbles into a murder investigation when the corrupt sanitation commissioner (Nicholas Joy) who had fired him is killed. When the murder weapon is found to be one of the brushes Red sells, he must fight to prove his innocence.

673500.title: Bell, Book and Candle
673500.description: A Greenwich Village witch falls for her dashing neighbor. When she learns he’s engaged, she casts a love spell but risks losing her powers for good.

692051.title: Hell House LLC III: Lake of Fire
692051.description: The haunted Abaddon Hotel is on the verge of being torn down when billionaire Russell Wynn buys it as the new home for his popular interactive show.

692051.title: Eat Brains Love
692051.description: Young love is tough, especially when the teens have a zombie virus and are trying to outrun the feds on what turns out to be a hilarious road trip.

692051.title: Silent Hill: Revelation
692051.description: After spending years on the run with her father, Heather discovers her true identity, which has made her the target of a dangerous cult.

692051.title: Dresden Files
692051.description: Harry uncovers a distasteful alliance while trying to protect his client from a hellion.

692051.title: Dresden Files
692051.description: Dresden gets himself mixed up in a turf war between vampire gangs when he's pressured to repay a debt.

692051.title: Day of the Dead 2: Contagium
692051.description: After a military hospital loses control of an experiment, a dangerous virus is unleashed that transforms human beings into zombies.

692051.title: Wolf Creek
692051.description: A group of international tourists embark on an outback adventure, only to find their tour driver has disappeared and been replaced with a mysterious man named Mick Taylor.

692051.title: Wolf Creek
692051.description: Discovering that Mick has left them in the middle of nowhere, the group realise that their trip of a lifetime has turned into a desperate bid for survival.

692051.title: Sweet 16
692051.description: A lonely girl tries to make new friends, but she might spend her 16th birthday alone behind bars, since every boy she meets soon ends up dead.

692051.title: Fear Itself
692051.description: Family man is in a bad accident. As he hovers between life and death, the guy in the bed next to him, a serial killer, switches bodies with him.

692051.title: Fear Itself
692051.description: A private investigator is hired to spy on a woman's husband - she suspects he's having an affair. He holes up in a house across the street, but soon begins to hear and see weird things and comes to think the house he's in is haunted.

692051.title: Grave Encounters
692051.description: A reality show crew filming inside an abandoned mental hospital realizes that the building is not only haunted, but isn't going to let them leave.

692051.title: The Taking of Deborah Logan
692051.description: An elderly woman battling Alzheimer's agrees to let a film crew document her condition, but what they discover is something far more malevolent.

692087.title: The Prayer Circle
692087.description: After an ex-con joins a prayer group, other members must challenge their perceptions as they learn that they have more in common than it seems.

692087.title: The Great Divide
692087.description: Crossing the bridge of love isn't easy for a group of couples in this comedy about hidden secrets, flaring tempers, spicy passions and new life.

692087.title: The Pastor's Secrets
692087.description: A new pastor tries to leave a positive legacy on his church, but his troubled past resurfaces. Will he find the strength to overcome his mistakes?

692087.title: I Used to Love Her

692087.title: Savage Girls
692087.description: Jillian returns to Watts after a troubled military discharge. Finding her family in hardship, she plans a risky heist, but survival has a deadly cost.

692087.title: Measure of Faith
692087.description: A family’s faith is tested after the death of their grandmother and matriarch reveals secrets and betrayals.

692087.title: I'm Charlie Walker
692087.description: Armed with only his charm and wit, the son of sharecroppers takes on a racist San Francisco corporation in the wake of a 1971 oil tanker disaster.

692087.title: Tales From the Crip

692087.title: Dangerous Seduction
692087.description: A business trip in Florida for a top sports reporter turns into love triangle trouble with his ex after a one-night-stand with his host’s daughter.

692087.title: Bonus Dad
692087.description: Riley faces her school bully, prompting Shannon to step in; Mia is thrilled Devin's making friends, while Tangi's housing plans for Shannon take a comical turn.

692087.title: Gang of Roses
692087.description: The fierce head of an all-female former gang that broke up gets them in the saddle again to hunt down treasure and avenge her sister’s death.

700412.description: Review suspect interviews as police try to get enough evidence for a conviction.

700412.title: Cause of Death
700412.description: Learn if a rare disease killed a man and if an operation ended another’s life.

700412.title: Cause of Death
700412.description: Deduce what killed a healthy young man and a recently vaccinated office worker.

700412.title: Cause of Death
700412.description: Ascertain what felled an active mom and one of Dr. Adeley’s former colleagues.

700412.title: Cause of Death
700412.description: Look at a young man’s death and determine if suicide could have been the cause.

700412.title: Cause of Death
700412.description: Unearth a surprising cause in the death of a young woman at a music festival.

700412.description: Labour alongside a woman giving birth in a locked-down hospital maternity ward.

700412.description: Find out how a prank 911 call puts firefighters and paramedics in danger.

700412.title: I, Hostage
700412.description: Join hostages in a library who learn one of their number is a police officer.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In November of 1994, when a Wells Fargo armored van disappeared from a Glendale, Arizona mall, local authorities and the FBI scrambled to recover it, and its cargo of nearly a million dollars. Six hours later, agents found the van, its driver shot dead inside and the money gone. It was a perfect hit by professionals who left no clue behind. Months passed before a solid lead developed. In January, a tip led agents to look into a former prison guard.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In New York, the FBI and local police join forces to battle the constant influx of Colombian cocaine into the city's ports. One detective goes undercover, posing as a Mafia wise-guy, and infiltrates a drug gang connected to Pablo Escobar's Medellin cartel. The detective must be bold, but cautious, taking on the role of a tough-guy, but always aware that if the gang suspects anything, they won't hesitate to kill him.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Puerto Rico, the death of a government witness, and the suspicious circumstances surrounding it, lead the FBI and local authorities to suspect corruption in the highest levels of the police force. With the help of a cooperating witness, investigators find the scope of the corruption is far greater that they first thought. Authorities struggle to capture the rouge officers, men who once swore to uphold the law, but now use their power to commit heinous crimes.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway. Although he proclaimed his innocence the FBI lab experts were able to link tool marks found on the frame with tools found in Gwaltney's home. Through the match of hairs and fibers and a unique test for detecting and identifying sperm, Gwaltney was placed at the scene of the crime.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: At 9:30 am on the morning of January 30, 1997, Richmond, VA police respond to a report of shots fired at a local bank. Two masked men brandishing automatic weapons confront, and open fire on officers responding to the call. The gunmen exit the bank, and retreat on foot, eventually eluding the officers. The FBI soon responds, only to find one bank teller dead, another wounded, and the bank's security guard shot four times, yet still alive.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A man is found suffocated in his Pennsylvania home, his checkbook, credit cards and vehicle appear to have been stolen. Fingerprints from the victim identify a recent escapee from a minimum-security prison, as well as his girlfriend. Investigators flag the dead man's credit cards, and are alerted when one is used in North Dakota. The FBI is called in and joins another task force already assembled because of a suspected kidnapping.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In Wisconsin, a varsity athlete is blindfolded, gagged, and shoved into a van by four gunmen. The kidnappers contact the victim's family and demand $30,000, but offer no instructions on how to transfer the money. The victim's family contacts the police. The boy's captors tell his family they have shot him, and will kill him if they do not receive their money. At an agreed upon drop site, FBI agents approach the captor's vehicle, only to watch them flee and quickly be followed by authorities.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1991, the Safe Streets Task Force, a joint FBI / Washington D.C. Metropolitan Police Department organization, begins conducting an investigation into the violent activities of a local gang called the K Street Crew. Gang members are suspected of involvement in several area homicides. The FBI approaches several witnesses, hoping to convince them to testify against the gang members. Seven potential witnesses are murdered during the course of the investigation.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In June of 2000, two gunmen rob a Seattle, WA bank, and flee on foot as officers chase them. One of the gunmen is killed in a firefight with police, the other escapes after assaulting a family and using their home to hide. The family helps FBI agents identify the man, who is suspected of several other robberies. Seattle SWAT teams, working with the FBI, search the home of the assailant's mother, and find ammunition matching that used at the bank robbery.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A California bank manager panics and calls in the FBI after the door to his vault refuses to open. Upon inspection, the vault has been blasted into from the ceiling, and over $2 million in valuables is gone. When agents find no clues as to the robbers or their whereabouts in California, they send details of the crime to other FBI field offices. It is not long before agents in Ohio are investigating a bank vault robbery that is strikingly similar to the California heist.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored. He then heads down the Adriatic coast through Croatia to pick up the trail that the Venetians followed, ending his journey on the beautiful island of Lopud, near Dubrovnik.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's famous barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

700407.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
700407.description: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

700407.title: Monty Don's Japanese Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don returns to Japan during the fiery blaze of autumn. He visits the three great gardens of Japan to learn how they protect the garden from the coming winter and learns how the Japanese are weaving nature into their concrete urban jungle.

700407.description: Monty Don returns to Japan during the fiery blaze of autumn. He visits the three great gardens of Japan to learn how they protect the garden from the coming winter and learns how the Japanese are weaving nature into their concrete urban jungle.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty's dividing his Pulmonaria and gives advice on frost-protection, Joe visits a tropical oasis outside Bristol, and Carol looks at Rowans from around the world.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty and the team celebrate the wonder of trees and explore the vital role they play in gardens and the wider landscape. Zoe Ball joins Toby Buckland on a visit to a tree project in North London.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty plants for pollinators in the Wildlife Garden and trims his box topiary cones. He also takes succulent leaf cuttings and continues the summer veg harvest. Meanwhile, Carol Klein visits stunning Italian-influenced gardens in Gloucestershire.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: As autumn gathers momentum, it's time to start putting the garden to bed for winter. Monty Don has some timely advice on what to do. Carol Klein meets a nurseryman in Herefordshire and together they indulge in the beauty of the Japanese maple.

700407.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don conducts a personal grand tour around Italy's magnificent gardens from the luxurious retreats of the moneyed north to the lavish hideaways of the romantic south. In this episode, he's in and around Rome, a powerbase of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created in history.

700407.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don is on a grand tour around Italy, this time visiting gardens both in Florence and around the sun-scorched Tuscan countryside. Monty discovers how, like a piece of sculpture, renaissance gardens were created as works of art, and how a group of Edwardian ex-pats mistakenly reinforced the idea that formal Italian gardens were flowerless.

700407.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don continues his grand garden tour of Italy. This time he is in Naples to visit some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After all the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the dramatic scenery of the Amalfi Coast to discover why, in the south, gardens are informal and, above all, filled with flowers.

700407.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don concludes his garden tour of Italy in the wealthy north where, in the Veneto and Lucca, extravagant pleasure gardens were created for flirtation and fun. In the Lakes, Monty meets up with the garden society, the Grandi Giardini Italiani, to peer over the fence at luxurious creations of the rich and famous. The journey ends on Lake Maggiore to see the most theatrical horticultural gem of Italy.

700407.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
700407.description: In Morocco, Monty discovers the wide variety of paradise gardens. He begins just outside the city of Marrakesh in an enormous royal walled meadow, The Agdal. From there he moves to the heart of the town where he comes upon a tiny garden where huge banana plants jostle with palms to create a secret paradise garden, a shelter from the busy world outside. And in another part of the city a rundown old palace has been turned into a stunning contemporary garden with a twist.

700407.title: Monty Don's Paradise Gardens
700407.description: In Turkey Monty is dazzled by an extraordinary display of the Ottoman Empire's favourite flower, the tulip, and learns of its sacred significance. Travelling further East to India he encounters a new type of spirituality in the tomb gardens of the Mughal Empire. Stunning mausoleums were set in vast gardens as places where an earthly king could enter a divine paradise.

actionmax.us.title: Trance
actionmax.us.description: Simon (James McAvoy), a fine-art auctioneer, joins a gang of thieves led by Franck (Vincent Cassel) to steal a priceless Goya painting. During the heist Simon suffers a head injury and awakes with no memory of where he hid the artwork. When torture and physical threats fail to break through his amnesia, Franck hires a hypnotherapist named Elizabeth (Rosario Dawson) to find the answer. But as Elizabeth probes the recesses of Simon's mind, the lines between truth and deceit start to blur. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2013

actionmax.us.title: Night on Earth
actionmax.us.description: This film presents five stories, each involving a cab ride and set in a different city around the world. In Los Angeles, no-nonsense taxi driver Corky (Winona Ryder) gets an engaging customer in the form of a Hollywood casting agent (Gena Rowlands), while a Parisian cabbie (Isaach de Bankolé) must contend with some rowdy African diplomats. Among the other tales, a standout is the Italian taxi ride that finds quirky driver Gino (Roberto Benigni) making a lively confession to an ailing priest. (Comedy drama, Drama) - 1992

actionmax.us.title: Leave No Trace
actionmax.us.description: A father and daughter live a perfect but mysterious existence in Forest Park, a beautiful nature reserve near Portland, Ore., rarely making contact with the world. But when a small mistake tips them off to authorities, they are sent on an increasingly erratic journey in search of a place to call their own. (Drama) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: The Transporter Refueled
actionmax.us.description: Frank Martin is living a less perilous lifestyle, or so he thinks, transporting classified packages for questionable people. Things get complicated when femme fatale Anna and her three accomplices orchestrate a bank heist and the kidnapping of Frank's father. It's all part of a grand plan to take down the human trafficker who victimized her years earlier. Now a pawn in her vengeful scheme, the former special-operations mercenary must use his covert skills to play Anna's dangerous game. (Action, Thriller) - 2015

actionmax.us.title: Mickey 17
actionmax.us.description: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact. (Science fiction, Comedy) - 2025

actionmax.us.title: Chasing Mavericks
actionmax.us.description: When 15-year-old surfing phenomenon Jay Moriarty discovers that the mythic Mavericks surf break, one of the biggest waves on Earth, actually exists near his California home, he becomes determined to conquer it. Jay enlists the aid of local surfing legend Frosty Hesson to train him to ride the Mavericks and live to tell about it. As Jay and Frosty carry on their quest to achieve the impossible, they develop a unique friendship that transforms both their lives. (Docudrama, Adventure) - 2012

actionmax.us.title: Inconceivable
actionmax.us.description: Angela develops a friendship with a mysterious woman named Katie and offers her a job as a live-in nanny. The natural bond soon turns into a dangerous obsession as Katie becomes overly attached to the family's young daughter. Enduring lies and manipulations, Angela and her husband realize that sweet Katie is actually trying to destroy their family from within. (Thriller, Drama) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: Atomic Blonde
actionmax.us.description: Sensual and savage, Lorraine Broughton is the most elite spy in MI6, an agent who's willing to use all of her lethal skills to stay alive during an impossible mission. With the Berlin Wall about to fall, she travels into the heart of the city to retrieve a priceless dossier and take down a ruthless espionage ring. Once there, she teams up with an embedded station chief to navigate her way through the deadliest game of spies. (Action, Thriller, LGBTQ) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: Kingsman: The Golden Circle
actionmax.us.description: With their headquarters destroyed and the world held hostage, members of Kingsman find new allies when they discover a spy organization in the United States known as Statesman. In an adventure that tests their strength and wits, the elite secret agents from both sides of the pond band together to battle a ruthless enemy and save the day, something that's becoming a bit of a habit for Eggsy. (Action, Adventure, Comedy) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: Little Shop of Horrors
actionmax.us.description: Meek flower shop assistant Seymour (Rick Moranis) pines for co-worker Audrey (Ellen Greene). During a total eclipse, he discovers an unusual plant he names Audrey II, which feeds only on human flesh and blood. The growing plant attracts a great deal of business for the previously struggling store. After Seymour feeds Audrey's boyfriend, Orin (Steve Martin), to the plant after Orin's accidental death, he must come up with more bodies for the increasingly bloodthirsty plant. (Musical comedy) - 1986

actionmax.us.title: Holla
actionmax.us.description: A mysterious killer stalks a sitcom actress (Shelli Boone) and her companions (Young Sir, Michael Bergin) on a weekend getaway in the wilderness. (Horror) - 2006

actionmax.us.title: Nerve
actionmax.us.description: Industrious high school senior Vee Delmonico (Emma Roberts) is tired of living life on the sidelines. Pressured by her friends, Vee decides to join Nerve, a popular online game that challenges players to accept a series of dares. It's not long before the adrenaline-fueled competition requires her to perform increasingly dangerous stunts. When Nerve begins to take a sinister turn, Vee finds herself in a high-stakes finale that will ultimately determine her entire future. (Thriller, Action, Adventure, Crime drama) - 2016

actionmax.us.title: Men
actionmax.us.description: Harper retreats to the countryside to be alone in the wake of a tragedy, but her unease at the town's leering and uncannily similar men grows into a fully fledged nightmare as her arrival awakens something primal in the forest. (Thriller, Horror) - 2022

actionmax.us.title: The Nun II
actionmax.us.description: An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak. (Horror, Thriller) - 2023

actionmax.us.title: Robin Hood
actionmax.us.description: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Historical drama) - 2010

actionmax.us.title: The Perfect Match
actionmax.us.description: Charlie (Terrence J) is a charming playboy who doesn't believe in serious relationships. His best friends bet him that if he commits to one woman for one month, he's bound to fall in love. Charlie accepts the seemingly easy challenge, but wasn't expecting to cross paths with the beautiful and mysterious Eva (Cassie Ventura). When Charlie coaxes her into a casual affair, Eva turns the tables on him, forcing the lifelong bachelor to question whether he wants more than just a one-night stand. (Romantic comedy) - 2016

actionmax.us.title: Super Troopers 2
actionmax.us.description: Fired for their previous shenanigans, former Vermont Highway Patrol officers Thorny, Farva, Rabbit, Foster and Mac get a shot at redemption from Capt. O'Hagan and Gov. Jessan. The wacky quintet must provide law enforcement for a French Canadian town that's transitioning to U.S. sovereignty. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties, a smuggling ring and a 1,300-pound bear. (Comedy) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: Room
actionmax.us.description: Held captive for years in an enclosed space, a woman and her young son finally gain their freedom, allowing the boy to experience the outside world for the first time. (Drama, Thriller) - 2015

actionmax.us.title: Mojave
actionmax.us.description: A down-and-out artist (Garrett Hedlund) has a dangerous and shocking encounter with an evil drifter (Oscar Isaac) in the desert, leading to terrifying consequences when the deadly stranger follows his unsuspecting victim home. (Thriller) - 2015

actionmax.us.title: Patti Cake$
actionmax.us.description: Fed up with life in her New Jersey hometown, Patricia Dombrowski, aka Patti Cake$, hopes to follow in the footsteps of her idol and hit the road to achieve stardom as a rapper. With help from her best friend, a mysterious musician and her loving grandmother, Patti leads the charge against an army of haters, unpaid bills and the broken dreams that are holding her back. (Drama, Music, Hip-Hop & rap) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: The Possession
actionmax.us.description: When their youngest daughter, Em (Natasha Calis), becomes strangely obsessed with an antique wooden box bought from a yard sale, parents Clyde (Jeffrey Dean Morgan) and Stephanie (Kyra Sedgwick) see little cause for alarm. However, Em becomes increasingly unstable, leading the couple to fear the presence of a malevolent force. To their horror, Clyde and Stephanie learn that the box contains a dybbuk, a dislocated spirit that inhabits -- and ultimately devours -- a human host. (Horror, Thriller) - 2012

actionmax.us.title: X-Men: First Class
actionmax.us.description: In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). Despite their vastly different backgrounds -- Charles grew up with a wealthy family, while Erik lost his parents at Auschwitz -- the two become close friends. As the world teeters on the brink of a nuclear war, Charles and Erik with other mutants join forces to save humanity. However, a situation soon tears the friends apart. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction) - 2011

actionmax.us.title: Extraction
actionmax.us.description: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative. (Thriller, Action) - 2015

actionmax.us.title: Rampage
actionmax.us.description: Primatologist Davis Okoye shares an unshakable bond with George, an extraordinarily intelligent, silverback gorilla that's been in his care since birth. When a rogue genetic experiment goes wrong, it causes George, a wolf and a reptile to grow to a monstrous size. As the mutated beasts embark on a path of destruction, Okoye teams up with a discredited genetic engineer and the military to secure an antidote and prevent a global catastrophe. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: Megan Leavey
actionmax.us.description: The true life story of Megan Leavey, a young Marine corporal whose unique discipline and bond with a military combat dog saved many lives during her deployment in Iraq. Assigned to clean up the K-9 unit after a disciplinary hearing, Leavey starts to identify with Rex, a particularly aggressive dog that she trains. Over the course of their service, Megan and Rex complete more than 100 missions until an improvised explosive device injures both, putting their fates in jeopardy. (War, Biography, Drama) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: Papillon
actionmax.us.description: The epic story of Henri Papillon Charrière, a safecracker from the Parisian underworld who is framed for murder and condemned to life in the notorious penal colony on Devil's Island. Determined to regain his freedom, Papillon forms an unlikely alliance with convicted counterfeiter Louis Dega, who in exchange for protection, agrees to finance Papillon's escape. (Adventure, Historical drama, Biography) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
actionmax.us.description: After months have passed without a culprit in her daughter's murder case, Mildred Hayes makes a bold move, painting three signs leading into her town with a controversial message directed at William Willoughby, the town's revered chief of police. When his second-in-command, Officer Dixon -- an immature mother's boy with a penchant for violence -- gets involved, the battle is only exacerbated. (Crime drama, Dark comedy) - 2017
