starzencore.us.title: The Italian Job
starzencore.us.description: After a heist in Venice, Steve turns on his partners in crime, killing safecracker John Bridger and keeping all the gold for himself; the rest of the team, including leader Charlie Croker, driver Handsome Rob, explosives man Left Ear and tech geek Lyle, vows revenge; they enlist the help of Bridger's daughter, Stella, and plot to recover the gold from Steve's Los Angeles mansion. (Crime drama, Thriller, Action) - 2003

starzencore.us.title: Non-Stop
starzencore.us.description: Alcoholic and world-weary, U.S. Air Marshal Bill Marks (Liam Neeson) lost his passion for his work long ago. Even though lives are potentially at stake during every flight, he sees the assignment as just a desk job. However, his "ordinary day at the office" becomes a high-stakes crisis during a flight to London. Marks receives a series of text messages demanding that he instruct the airline to transfer $150 million into an offshore account, or a passenger will die every 20 minutes. (Action, Thriller) - 2014

starzencore.us.title: The Take
starzencore.us.description: A rogue CIA agent (Idris Elba) forms an unlikely partnership with a pickpocket (Richard Madden) to stop a terrorist conspiracy in Paris. (Action, Thriller) - 2016

starzencore.us.title: Jurassic Park III
starzencore.us.description: After being persuaded by a wealthy businessman to conduct an aerial tour of Isla Sorna, InGen's second site for a failed Jurassic Park experiment, Dr. Alan Grant discovers the true reason for his invitation. A tragic accident maroons the party of seven, and they must attempt to escape with their lives. (Adventure, Action, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2001

starzencore.us.title: Like a Boss
starzencore.us.description: Best friends Mia and Mel run their own cosmetics company -- a business they built from the ground up. But they're also in over their heads financially, and the prospect of a buyout offer from an industry titan proves too tempting to pass up. The beauty business is now about to get ugly as the proposal puts Mia and Mel's lifelong friendship to the ultimate test. (Comedy) - 2020

Though negotiations seem to be going well, Parrish can't stop the deadly Battle of Little Big Horn. Many die, but when he helps Sitting Bull survive, Parrish is charged with crimes against the government, and he will be executed unless Grant steps in. (Western) - 1954

Later, Dancer takes on the identity of a deceased marshal and comes into conflict with a ruthless band of criminals but receives help from a renowned old war buddy. Dancer also finally gets a chance to face off against his sibling's real murderer, Bert Slocum (Barry Kelley), in a tense showdown. (Western) - 1949

And when the scheming Hamilton relocates to their small town to pursue Rosalee in the wake of their initial meeting, a horrified Pete must struggle to win her heart. starzencoreclassic.us.title: Last Chance Harvey

starzencoreclassic.us.description: Under cover of night, vampires engage in an age-old battle with their sworn enemies, the Lycans, a clan of violent werewolves. Selene, a vampire orphaned in the wake of a bloody Lycan attack, works for the vampire clan as a trained killer. When the Lycans take a mysterious interest in Michael Corvin, an exceptional mortal doctor, Selene struggles to save him from Lucian, a ruthless Lycan leader hell-bent on ending the vampire bloodline. starzencoreclassic.us.description: Fresh (Sean Nelson) is a 12-year-old drug dealer who finds himself trapped in a web of poverty, corruption and racial tension in Brooklyn, New York. When his drug-addict sister Nichole (N'Bushe Wright) starts sleeping with local drug lord Esteban (Giancarlo Esposito), Fresh calls upon the skills he learned playing chess with his alcoholic father and speed-chess champion Sam (Samuel L. Jackson) and devises a complex strategy that will free both himself and his sister. (Drama) - 1994

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Blue Steel
starzencoreclassic.us.description: When rookie cop Megan Turner (Jamie Lee Curtis) kills a convenience store robber, she does not notice when psychopathic commodities trader Eugene Hunt (Ron Silver) takes the dead man's gun. With no weapon at the crime scene, the police hold Turner accountable for killing an unarmed man. Meanwhile, Hunt uses the stolen weapon to go on a killing spree. Turner teams up with detective Nick Mann (Clancy Brown) to clear her name and catch the killer. An unexpected romance complicates matters. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1990

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Wonderland
starzencoreclassic.us.description: In this fact-based film, John Holmes (Val Kilmer) is one of the most successful porn stars of all time. But, when his rampant drug abuse forces him into prostitution, both his disapproving wife, Sharon (Lisa Kudrow), and his 16-year-old girlfriend, Dawn (Kate Bosworth), are on the verge of leaving him. As John sinks lower and lower into Hollywood, Calif.'s criminal underworld, he meets a seedy drug lord (Eric Bogosian) and finds himself caught up in a tragic chain of events. (Crime drama, Biography, Drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 2003

themoviechannel.us.title: Up in the Air
themoviechannel.us.description: An idea from a young, new co-worker (Anna Kendrick) would put an end to the constant travel of corporate downsizer Ryan Bingham (George Clooney), so he takes her on a tour to demonstrate the importance of face-to-face meetings with those they must fire. While mentoring his colleague, he arranges hookups with another frequent-flier (Vera Farmiga), and his developing feelings for the woman prompt him to see others in a new light. (Comedy drama, Romance) - 2009

themoviechannel.us.title: Baby Driver
themoviechannel.us.description: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: Case 39
themoviechannel.us.description: In her many years as a social worker, Emily Jenkins (Renée Zellweger) thinks she has seen it all -- until she meets 10-year-old Lilith (Jodelle Ferland) and the girl's cruel parents. When the parents try to harm the child, Emily assumes custody of Lilith while looking for a foster family. However, she soon finds that dark forces surround the seemingly innocent child, and the more she tries to protect Lilith, the more horrors she encounters. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2009

themoviechannel.us.title: Terms of Endearment
themoviechannel.us.description: Widow Aurora Greenway (Shirley MacLaine) and her daughter, Emma (Debra Winger), have a strong bond, but Emma marries teacher Flap Horton (Jeff Daniels) against her mother's wishes. When the marriage grows sour due to Flap's cheating, Emma eventually splits from him, returning to her mother, who is involved with a former astronaut (Jack Nicholson). Soon, Emma learns that she has terminal cancer. In the hospital, supported by Aurora, she tries to make peace with Flap and her children. (Comedy drama) - 1983

themoviechannel.us.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
themoviechannel.us.description: Under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for moms: Christmas. As if creating the perfect holiday for their families isn't hard enough, they'll have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers when they come to visit. (Holiday, Comedy) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: The Cradle of Life
themoviechannel.us.description: Fearless explorer Lara Croft (Angelina Jolie) tries to locate Pandora's box before criminals Jonathan Reiss (Ciarán Hinds) and Chen Lo (Simon Yam) use it for evil. According to myth, the box holds deadly organisms that could kill millions of people. With her old partner, Terry (Gerard Butler), Croft goes on a hunt that takes her from Europe to Asia to Africa, where pal Kosa (Djimon Hounsou) helps her. Along the way, Croft rappels down cliffs, scuba dives and decimates many male opponents. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Thriller) - 2003

themoviechannel.us.title: Almost Famous
themoviechannel.us.description: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone Magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe, William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother. (Comedy drama, Music, Rock, Drama) - 2000

themoviechannel.us.title: Nine
themoviechannel.us.description: Italian film director Guido Contini (Daniel Day-Lewis) grapples with epic crises in his personal and professional lives. At the same time, he must strike a balance of the demands of numerous women in his life, including his wife (Marion Cotillard), his mistress (Penélope Cruz), and his confidant (Judi Dench). (Musical, Romance) - 2009

themoviechannel.us.title: Asylum

themoviechannel.us.title: The King's Speech
themoviechannel.us.description: England's Prince Albert must ascend the throne as King George VI, but he has a speech impediment. Knowing that the country needs her husband to be able to communicate effectively, Elizabeth hires Lionel Logue, an Australian actor and speech therapist, to help him overcome his stammer. An extraordinary friendship develops between the two men, as Logue uses unconventional means to teach the monarch how to speak with confidence. (Historical drama, Biography) - 2010

themoviechannel.us.title: The English Patient
themoviechannel.us.description: The sweeping expanses of the Sahara are the setting for a passionate love affair in this adaptation of Michael Ondaatje's novel. A badly burned man, Laszlo de Almasy (Ralph Fiennes), is tended to by a nurse, Hana (Juliette Binoche), in an Italian monastery near the end of World War II. His past is revealed through flashbacks involving a married Englishwoman (Kristin Scott Thomas) and his work mapping the African landscape. Hana learns to heal her own scars as she helps the dying man. (Romance, War, Historical drama) - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
themoviechannel.us.description: To be young and carefree amid the blue waters and idyllic landscape of sun-drenched Italy in the late 1950s; that's la dolce vita Tom Ripley (Matt Damon) craves- and Dickie Greenleaf (Jude Law) leads. When Dickie's father asks Tom to bring his errant playboy son back home to America, Dickie and his beautiful expatriate girlfriend, Marge Sherwood (Gwyneth Paltrow), never suspect the dangerous extremes to which Ripley will go to make their lifestyle his own. (Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery, Romance) - 1999

themoviechannel.us.title: The Beldham

themoviechannel.us.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider

themoviechannel.us.title: Edge of Tomorrow

Killed within moments, Cage finds himself thrown into a time loop, in which he relives the same brutal fight -- and his death -- over and over again. However, Cage's fighting skills improve with each encore, bringing him and a comrade (Emily Blunt) ever closer to defeating the aliens. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2014

themoviechannel.us.title: The Lovely Bones

As she observes their daily lives, she must balance her thirst for revenge with her desire for her family to heal. (Drama, Mystery, Fantasy, Thriller) - 2009

themoviechannel.us.title: Primal Fear

His latest case involves an altar boy, accused of brutally murdering the archbishop of Chicago. Vail finds himself up against his ex-pupil and ex-lover, but as the case progresses and the Church's dark secrets are revealed, Vail finds that what appeared a simple case takes on a darker, more dangerous aspect. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: Kiss the Girls

Once he consults with police Detective Nick Ruskin (Cary Elwes), Cross believes that the disappearance is the work of an insane killer known as "Casanova." Meanwhile, Dr. Kate McTiernan (Ashley Judd) is kidnapped by this criminal and witnesses many other imprisoned women in his lair. After narrowly escaping, McTiernan teams up with Cross to try to apprehend the deranged Casanova. (Mystery, Thriller, Crime drama) - 1997

themoviechannel.us.title: The Prophecy

Caught in a cosmic battle in which even Lucifer (Viggo Mortensen) plays a part, a liturgically minded cop (Elias Koteas) moves heaven and earth to protect the child. (Fantasy, Thriller) - 1995

themoviechannel.us.title: The Prophecy II

Helping Gabriel track Rosales down is a suicidal teenager (Brittany Murphy). Meanwhile, good angel Danyael (Russell Wong) marshals all his heavenly powers to protect Rosales and her child from Gabriel's clutches. (Horror) - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: The Prophecy 3: The Ascent

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Yentl
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Rebbe Mendel is a single father who teaches the Talmud, a sacred text of Judaism, to the boys of his small Polish town. Behind closed doors, he also instructs his daughter, Yentl, despite the fact that girls are forbidden to study religious scripture. When Yentl's father dies, she still has a strong desire to learn about her faith -- so she disguises herself as a male, enrolls in a religious school, and unexpectedly finds love along the way. (Musical, Drama, Romance) - 1983

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: What's Up, Doc?
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Two researchers have come to San Francisco to compete for a research grant in music. The man seems a bit distracted, and that was before he met a strange woman who has devoted her life to confusing and embarrassing him. At the same time a woman has her jewels stolen, and a government whistleblower arrives with his stolen top secret papers. (Comedy) - 1972

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Elmer the Great
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Elmer Kane (Joe E. Brown) is an arrogant but gullible baseball player who must leave his Gentryville sweetheart, Nellie (Patricia Ellis), to join the Chicago Cubs. Once on board, his teammates take advantage of his gullibility with practical jokes, and the management hides the letters that come from Nellie. When she comes to Chicago to see him play the World Series, a series of misunderstandings and bad judgments threatens to ruin both his love life and career. (Comedy) - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Random Harvest
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A veteran of World War I, Charles Rainier (Ronald Colman) has lost all memory of his life before the war. Left to wander, Rainier meets a showgirl, Paula (Greer Garson), with whom he falls in love. Rainier and Paula are soon happily married, but when Rainier travels out of town, a car hits him -- erasing the memories of his life with Paula, but restoring those of his life before the war. While he returns to his previous life, Paula tries to find a way to be reunited with her husband. (Drama) - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Anthony Adverse
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Based on the novel by Hervey Allen, this expansive drama follows the many adventures of the eponymous hero (Fredric March). Abandoned at a convent by his heartless nobleman father, Don Luis (Claude Rains), Anthony is later mentored by his kind grandfather, John Bonnyfeather (Edmund Gwenn), and falls for the beautiful Angela Giuseppe (Olivia de Havilland). When circumstances separate Anthony and Angela, and he embarks on a long journey, he must find his way back to her, no matter what the cost. (Romance) - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: They Won't Forget
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The town of Flodden is in an uproar when a pretty student is found dead on Confederate Memorial Day, but District Attorney Griffin (Claude Rains) sees it as an opportunity. Thinking the case could propel him into the U.S. Senate, he begins an extensive smear campaign against the girl's teacher, Robert Hale (Edward Norris), an outsider who hails from New York. Despite only circumstantial evidence, Hale is convicted, and locals threaten vigilante justice if he isn't executed. (Drama) - 1937

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: I Am a Fugitive From a Chain Gang
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Jaded World War I veteran James Allen (Paul Muni) dreams of creating a new life, but those dreams are shattered when he is implicated in a robbery and sentenced to 10 years on a chain gang. The brutal prison conditions compel James to break out and flee to Chicago, where he assumes a new identity and, over time, becomes a successful businessman. His freedom and happiness are threatened, however, when his scheming landlady (Glenda Farrell) discovers his secret and threatens to blackmail him. (Docudrama) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Little Caesar
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An aspiring small-town criminal, Caesar "Rico" Bandello (Edward G. Robinson) relocates to Chicago to hit the big time, accompanied by his buddy, Joe Massara (Douglas Fairbanks Jr.). While Rico makes a name for himself in the underworld, Joe decides to leave the life of crime and ventures into show business, where he meets the lovely dancer Olga (Glenda Farrell). Though Rico and Joe try to honor their friendship, eventually their choices take them down dramatically different paths. (Crime drama) - 1930

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Thirty Seconds Over Tokyo
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: During World War II, Lt. Col. James H. Doolittle (Spencer Tracy) leads the U.S. Air Force in a bombing mission over Japan. Doolittle and his men stage a successful attack on Tokyo, but most pilots run out of fuel while returning from the raid. Many are forced to land on Japanese soil, but Capt. Ted Lawson (Van Johnson), who has a pregnant wife at home, crash-lands in the sea off the coast of China. Stranded, Lawson must heroically endure a series of harrowing challenges to make it back home. (War) - 1944

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Gaslight
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After the death of her famous opera-singing aunt, Paula (Ingrid Bergman) is sent to study in Italy to become a great opera singer as well. While there, she falls in love with the charming Gregory Anton (Charles Boyer). The two return to London, and Paula begins to notice strange goings-on: missing pictures, strange footsteps in the night and gaslights that dim without being touched. As she fights to retain her sanity, her new husband's intentions come into question. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1944

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Angela Lansbury re-creates her Tony-winning performance of the opportunistic Mrs. Lovett, joining the macabre doings of the Demon Barber of Fleet Street, in Stephen Sondheim's Broadway musical. (Special, Musical, Drama, Thriller) - 1982-09-12

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Brides of Dracula
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Van Helsing (Peter Cushing) drives a stake through the heart of a vampire baron (David Peel) who even bites his own mother (Martita Hunt). (Horror) - 1960

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Blood From the Mummy's Tomb
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An archaeologist (Andrew Keir) and his team bring back an embalmed Egyptian princess who takes over his daughter (Valerie Leon). (Horror) - 1971

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Dracula Has Risen From the Grave
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The vampire count (Christopher Lee) bites a tavern waitress and a Monsignor's (Rupert Davies) niece (Veronica Carlson), then falls on something sharp. (Horror) - 1968

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Dracula A.D. 1972
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Professor Van Helsing Jr. (Peter Cushing) protects his granddaughter (Stephanie Beacham) from the vampire count (Christopher Lee), brought back by London hippies. (Horror) - 1972

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Curse of Frankenstein
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Victor Frankenstein is a brilliant scientist willing to stop at nothing in his quest to reanimate a deceased body. After alienating his longtime friend and partner, Paul Krempe, with his extreme methods, Frankenstein assembles a hideous creature out of dead body parts and succeeds in bringing it to life. But the monster is not as obedient or docile as Frankenstein expected, and it runs amok, resulting in murder and mayhem. (Horror) - 1957

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Horror of Dracula
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: On a search for his missing friend Jonathan Harker (John Van Eyssen), vampire hunter Dr. Van Helsing (Peter Cushing) is led to Count Dracula's (Christopher Lee) castle. Upon arriving, Van Helsing finds an undead Harker in Dracula's crypt and discovers that the count's next target is Harker's ailing fiancée, Lucy Holmwood (Carol Marsh). With the help of her brother, Arthur (Michael Gough), Van Helsing struggles to protect Lucy and put an end to Count Dracula's parasitic reign of terror. (Horror) - 1958

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Mummy
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: British archaeologists defile the tomb of an Egyptian princess (Yvonne Furneaux) and her buried-alive lover (Christopher Lee). (Horror) - 1959

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Mystic
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An American crook persuades a fake medium and her crew to set up shop in New York. (Drama) - 1925

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: West of Zanzibar
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When magician Phroso's (Lon Chaney) beloved wife, Anna (Jacqueline Gadsden), leaves him for ivory merchant Crane (Lionel Barrymore), the two men fight and Phroso is left paralyzed from the waist down. After Anna's sudden death, Phroso takes revenge on Crane by spiriting Anna's baby away to Africa, where he rears her in a brothel and keeps her enslaved with drugs. But when Crane and Phroso -- now known as "Dead-Legs" Flint -- meet again after 18 years, Crane delivers some shocking news. (Adventure) - 1928

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Thirteenth Chair
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A medium (Margaret Wycherly) holds a seance to clear her daughter (Leila Hyams) of murder in colonial India. (Mystery) - 1930

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Mark of the Vampire
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Sir Borotyn (Holmes Herbert), a prominent Prague resident, is discovered murdered in his home, with all indications pointing to a vampire assault. The victim's friend, Baron Otto (Jean Hersholt), and the physician who analyzes the body are certain that the vampire is the mysterious Count Mora (Bela Lugosi), or perhaps his daughter (Carroll Borland), but receive little help from the law. Professor Zelen (Lionel Barrymore), an expert in the occult, is called in to assist with the investigation. (Horror, Mystery) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Devil Doll
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Wrongfully convicted of a robbery and murder, Paul Lavond breaks out of prison with a genius scientist who has devised a way to shrink humans. When the scientist dies during the escape, Lavond heads for his lab, using the shrinking technology to get even with those who framed him, and vindicate himself in both the public eye and the eyes of his daughter, Lorraine. When an accident leaves a crazed assistant dead, however, Lavond must again make an escape. (Horror) - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Freaks
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When trapeze artist Cleopatra (Olga Baclanova) learns that circus midget Hans (Harry Earles) has an inheritance, she marries the lovesick, diminutive performer, all the while planning to steal his fortune and run off with her lover, strong man Hercules (Henry Victor). When Hans' friends and fellow performers discover what is going on, they band together and carry out a brutal revenge that leaves Hercules and Cleopatra knowing what it truly means to be a freak. (Horror) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Becoming Hitchcock -- The Legacy of Blackmail
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Highlighting the birth of the Hitchcock Touch at a period when talking pictures first emerged and exploring trademark themes like murder, suspense and blondes. (Documentary) - 2024

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Blackmail
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: During a date, Alice White (Anny Ondra) has a fight with her boyfriend, Scotland Yard Officer Frank Webber (John Longden), and decides to leave with an artist named Mr. Crewe (Cyril Ritchard). Whey they get to the artist's flat, Mr. Crewe attempts to force himself on Alice, and she kills him to defend herself. Frank investigates the case and, after realizing Alice is the culprit, seeks to help her. However, a thief (Donald Calthrop) with blackmail on his mind complicates matters. (Thriller) - 1929

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The 39 Steps
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: While on vacation in London, Canadian Richard Hannay becomes embroiled in an international spy ring related to the mysterious "39 steps." Then he meets agent Annabella Smith, who is soon killed in his apartment. He must elude the police, who are hunting him for murder, while he tries to stop Professor Jordan from sending secrets out of the country. Hannay is assisted by Pamela, an unwilling accomplice who discovers the truth. (Thriller, Mystery) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Dial M for Murder
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Ex-tennis pro Tony Wendice (Ray Milland) wants to have his wealthy wife, Margot (Grace Kelly), murdered so he can get his hands on her inheritance. When he discovers her affair with Mark Halliday (Robert Cummings), he comes up with the perfect plan to kill her. He blackmails an old acquaintance into carrying out the murder, but the carefully-orchestrated set-up goes awry, and Margot stays alive. Now Wendice must frantically scheme to outwit the police and avoid having his plot detected. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 1954

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: North by Northwest
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: This classic suspense film finds New York City ad executive Roger O. Thornhill (Cary Grant) pursued by ruthless spy Phillip Vandamm (James Mason) after Thornhill is mistaken for a government agent. Hunted relentlessly by Vandamm's associates, the harried Thornhill ends up on a cross-country journey, meeting the beautiful and mysterious Eve Kendall (Eva Marie Saint) along the way. Soon Vandamm's henchmen close in on Thornhill, resulting in a number of iconic action sequences. (Thriller) - 1959

NSW-SydneyFOXSPORTS506.au.description: Started in 2014, the team racing series features some of the top drivers competing at the more renowned tracks around the continent, as they look to finish with the fastest time to gain the most points with their eyes set on the series championship.

NSW-SydneyFOXSPORTS506.au.title: Moto2 : Indonesia Race

NSW-SydneyFOXSPORTS506.au.description: Championship contenders Jorge Martin and Marc Marquez go head-to-head at Mandalika, with eleven sprint race wins between them this season.

NSW-SydneyFOXSPORTS506.au.title: MotoGP : Indonesia Race

BBCSelect.us.description: S23 E5 The Trial of a Time Lord: Part 5 The TARDIS arrives on Thoros-Beta, homeworld of the Doctor 's old foe, Sil.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S23 E6 The Trial of a Time Lord: Part 6 Yrcanos and Peri are seemingly betrayed by the addled Doctor.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S23 E7 The Trial of a Time Lord: Part 7 Kiv's brain rejects his new body and Crozier is forced to rethink his plan.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S23 E8 The Trial of a Time Lord: Part 8 Crozier has selected Peri to be the Kiv's new host body - with devastating results.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S23 E9 The Trial of a Time Lord: Part 9 The Doctor suspects Professor Laskey's party of a series of murders.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S23 E10 The Trial of a Time Lord: Part 10 The Vervoids begin to attack the crew and passengers.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S23 E11 The Trial of a Time Lord: Part 11 Bruchner plans to send the Hyperion III into the black hole of Tartarus.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S23 E12 The Trial of a Time Lord: Part 12 The Doctor realises that if he can speed up the Vervoids life span, they will decay.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S23 E13 The Trial of a Time Lord: Part 13 The Valeyard's true identity is revealed and the trial aborted.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S23 E14 The Trial of a Time Lord: Part 14 The Valeyard has created a weapon within the Matrix that will destroy the Time Lords.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E1 Time and the Rani: Part 1 A newly regenerated Doctor is taken to the Rani’s base by Urak the Tetrap, while Mel meets some of the Lakertyans – and falls into one of the Rani’s traps.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E2 Time and the Rani: Part 2 The Rani’s impersonation of Mel backfires badly because Urak can't tell the difference, while the Doctor attempts to learn the secret of the Loyhargil.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E3 Time and the Rani: Part 3 The furious Rani begins to slaughter the Lakertyans, so Mel rallies the survivors, while the Doctor is readied to donate his mind to the Rani’s grotesque experiment.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E4 Time and the Rani: Part 4 As Mel convinces the Lakertyans fight back, the Tetraps turn on the Rani and the Doctor ensures the missile is deflected away from the asteroid.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S23 E5 The Trial of a Time Lord: Part 5 The TARDIS arrives on Thoros-Beta, homeworld of the Doctor 's old foe, Sil.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E5 Paradise Towers: Part 1 The legendary Paradise Towers is supposed to be the height of luxury but when the Doctor and Mel arrive, they find it is as far from a paradise as possible.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E6 Paradise Towers: Part 2 With the Doctor condemned to death by the caretakers and their bizarre rulebook, Mel faces cannibalistic OAPS. Is Pex going to be the true hero of Paradise Towers?

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E7 Paradise Towers: Part 3 Mel and Pex play cat and mouse with the lethal cleaner robots while the Doctor and the surviving Kangs learn all about Kroagnon the Great Architect.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E8 Paradise Towers: Part 4 Kroagnon has been reborn, and is using the Chief Caretaker’s reanimated corpse to move around Paradise Towers. To stop him the Doctor must teach the residents teamwork.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E9 Delta and the Bannermen: Part 1 The Doctor and Mel win a trip to Disneyland in 1959 but after an accident in space, they actually end up in South Wales instead, along with an assassin and his intended victim.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E10 Delta and the Bannermen: Part 2 Gavrok and the Bannermen have arrived on Earth, searching for Delta and slaughter the holidaymakers without compunction to draw her out.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E11 Delta and the Bannermen: Part 3 As Billy and Ray do what they can to help save Delta and the baby, the Doctor and Goronwy the beekeeper face Gavrok and his Bannermen one last time.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E12 Dragonfire: Part 1 On Iceworld, the Doctor and Mel meet Ace, who has found herself there after a timestorm. While Ace nearly joins Kane’s mercenaries, the Doctor and Glitz explore the ice caverns.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E13 Dragonfire: Part 2 The Doctor and Glitz meet the infamous dragon, which is really a biomechanoid. Meanwhile Kane turns on his allies, as he cannot trust anyone in his search for the dragonfire.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S24 E14 Dragonfire: Part 3 Shown the archive by the biomechanoid, the Doctor discovers that Kane is from the dead world of Proamon. Mel witnesess the destruction of the Nosferatu and Ace faces temptation.

BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E3 Remembrance of the Daleks: Part 3 The Doctor discovers the difference between the two Dalek factions and why they want a stellar manipulator.

BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E4 Remembrance of the Daleks: Part 4 The streets of East London shake under a civil war being fought between the Daleks.

BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E5 The Happiness Patrol: Part 1 The Happiness Patrol walk the streets of Terra Alpha, destroying all the killjoys, on the orders of the despotic Helen A. And in the Kandy Kitchen, something terrible lurks.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E6 The Happiness Patrol: Part 2 The Doctor escapes the Kandyman while Ace meets the Pipe People. Later, fleeing for her life, Ace is captured and selected to audition for the Happiness Patrol.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E7 The Happiness Patrol: Part 3 As the Doctor leads the Pipe People towards reclaiming their world, Helen A faces betrayal from those closest to her and the Kandyman comes to a sticky end.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E8 Silver Nemesis: Part 1 A group of Neo-Nazis in South America are seeking the Nemesis Statue – as is a shuttle full of Cybermen and the mysterious Lady Peinforte from the 17th century.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E9 Silver Nemesis: Part 2 The Cybermen have the Nemesis Statue but Lady Peinforte and Richard fight back because they were prepared with gold-tipped arrows and De Flores still has a plan to set in motion.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E10 Silver Nemesis: Part 3 The Nemesis Statue is alive, thanks to Lady Peinforte's insanity, and with De Flores's Nazi’s wiped out by the Cybermen, Nemesis claims it has secrets to reveal.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E11 The Greatest Show in the Galaxy: Part 1 Bellboy and Flowerchild escape the Psychic Circus but are pursued by the Chief Clown. The Doctor and Ace meet other visitors to Segonax, some of whom are not what they seem.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E12 The Greatest Show in the Galaxy: Part 2 The mysterious family watching the acts within the ring, dissatisfied with Nord, destroy him. Captain Cook goes to extreme measures to ensure he’s not the next to displease them.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E13 The Greatest Show in the Galaxy: Part 3 Ace and Bellboy team up to stop the Chief Clown while the Doctor realises that he is next into the ring. The Captain has another trick up his sleeve and shows Mags's true colours.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S25 E14 The Greatest Show in the Galaxy: Part 4 The Gods of Ragnarok are revealed and while waiting for Ace to escape the Chief Clown, the Doctor must entertain them as long as possible in the dimension of the Dark Circus.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E1 Battlefield: Part 1 As UNIT are transporting a nuclear warhead around Carbury, knights in armour arrive to contine waging a war that began thousands of years ago, but in a wholly different dimension.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E2 Battlefield: Part 2 The Doctor and Ace explore King Arthur’s spaceship deep under Lake Vortigern, while Brigadier Lethbridge-Stewart arrives in Carbury where he encounters Morgaine.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E3 Battlefield: Part 3 Furious at her inability to find and engage Arthur in battle, Morgaine threatens to unleash the Destroyer upon the planet unless the Doctor gives her what she wants.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E4 Battlefield: Part 4 The Brigadier slays the Destroyer while Morgaine takes control of UNIT's nuclear warhead and prepares to start a countdown that will destroy Earth forever.

The crew members, known as yachties, live aboard the luxurious, privately owned vessels while making sure that their demanding clients' ever-changing needs are met. The yachties share a passion for a job that allows them to visit some of the world's most beautiful places. Each episode features a different group of passengers -- ranging from millionaires to hard-partying friends -- as they head out for a marine adventure. wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

discoverywest.us.title: Homestead Rescue : Kentucky Calamity

discoverywest.us.title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan

discoverywest.us.title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan

discoverywest.us.title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers

discoverywest.us.title: Gold Rush : A Midas Mess

fxm.us.title: Enemy Mine
fxm.us.description: During a war between humans and the reptilian Drac race, spaceship pilot Willis Davidge ends up stranded on an alien world, along with enemy fighter Jeriba Shigan. While both Willis and his Drac counterpart can breathe on the planet, the environment and its creatures are relatively hostile, forcing the two to work together to survive. As time goes by, Willis and Jeriba become unlikely friends, though their unique relationship faces considerable challenges. (Science fiction) - 1985

fxm.us.title: The Earth Dies Screaming
fxm.us.description: An astronaut (Willard Parker) returns from a test flight to find England overtaken by alien-controlled robots which turn corpses into zombies. (Science fiction) - 1964

fxm.us.title: The Alligator People
fxm.us.description: Newly married nurse Joyce Webster (Beverly Garland) doesn't know what to think when her husband, Paul (Richard Crane), disappears during a train ride. She hires private investigators and eventually tracks him to an old bayou plantation, where the owner (Frieda Inescort) insists she's never heard of Paul. Joyce sticks around anyway and soon learns that local doctor Mark Sinclair (George Macready) has been using a life-altering alligator serum on the town's residents, and that Paul is among them. (Horror) - 1959

fxm.us.title: The Fly
fxm.us.description: When scientist Andre Delambre (Al Hedison) tests his matter transporter on himself, an errant housefly makes its way into the transportation chamber, and things go horribly wrong. As a result, Delambre's head and arm are now that of the insect. Slowly losing himself to the fly, Delambre turns to his wife, Helene (Patricia Owens), for help. But when tragedy strikes, Delambre's brother (Vincent Price) and Inspector Charas (Herbert Marshall) are forced to pick up the investigation. (Horror, Science fiction) - 1958

fxm.us.title: The Curse of the Fly
fxm.us.description: Scantily clad Patricia Stanley (Carole Gray) breaks out of a mental hospital and is picked up by passing motorist Martin Delambre (George Baker). The two do not reveal much about themselves to each other, but nevertheless decide to get married. At the Delambre family mansion, Patricia meets Martin's father, Henri (Brian Donlevy), an eccentric scientist. Snooping about the grounds, she discovers evidence of the family's strange experiments in teleportation and the grisly results thereof. (Horror, Science fiction, Mystery, Drama) - 1965

fxm.us.title: The Horror of It All
fxm.us.description: Yankee salesman Jack (Pat Boone) wants to marry Cynthia Marley (Erica Rogers), and they travel to her family's English estate to break the good news. Cynthia warns that the family is a bit odd, which proves to be an understatement. One relative is an ex-thespian who still believes he's in a play, another behaves like a vampire and a third is imprisoned in the cellar due to his violent tendencies. But things get really sinister when the Marleys start succumbing to violent fates, one by one. (Horror) - 1964

fxm.us.title: Witchcraft
fxm.us.description: For generations, the Whitlocks and the Laniers have been feuding, including when Vanessa Whitlock (Yvette Rees), accused of being a witch, was buried alive centuries ago. Now Bill Lanier (Jack Hedley) wants to dig up a burial ground for development purposes, and Morgan Whitlock (Lon Chaney Jr.) tries to stop him. Soon, unexplainable accidents start to happen to members of the Lanier family, throwing suspicion on Morgan. The real truth Bill discovers is much more sinister than he expected. (Horror) - 1964

fxm.us.title: The Fury
fxm.us.description: When a devious plot separates CIA agent Peter Sandza (Kirk Douglas) from his son, Robin (Andrew Stevens), the distraught father manages to see through the ruse. Taken because of his psychic abilities, Robin is being held by Ben Childress (John Cassavetes), who is studying people with supernatural powers in hopes of developing their talents as weapons. Soon Peter pairs up with Gillian (Amy Irving), a teen who has telekinesis, to find and rescue Robin. (Thriller, Horror) - 1978

fxm.us.title: Arachnophobia
fxm.us.description: After a nature photographer (Mark L. Taylor) dies on assignment in Venezuela, a poisonous spider hitches a ride in his coffin to his hometown in rural California, where arachnophobe Dr. Ross Jennings (Jeff Daniels) has just moved in with his wife, Molly (Harley Jane Kozak), and young son. As town residents start turning up dead, Jennings begins to suspect spiders, and must face his fears as he and no-nonsense exterminator Delbert McClintock (John Goodman) fight to stop a deadly infestation. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1990

fxm.us.title: The Grudge
fxm.us.description: A detective investigates a murder scene that has a connection to a case that her new partner handled in the past. The killings occurred in a haunted house that passes on a ghostly curse to those who dare enter it. Soon, the curse spreads to a terminally ill woman and her husband, and another unsuspecting couple who were in the wrong place at the wrong time. (Horror, Thriller) - 2020

fxm.us.title: Disturbia
fxm.us.description: Ever since his father died, young Kale (Shia LaBeouf) has become increasingly sullen and withdrawn, until he finds himself under house arrest. With cabin fever setting in, he turns his attention to spying on his neighbors, becoming increasingly suspicious that one of them is a serial killer. However, he wonders if he is right, or if his overactive imagination is getting the better of him. (Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery) - 2007

fxm.us.title: The Village
fxm.us.description: The population of a small, isolated countryside village believes that their alliance with the mysterious creatures that inhabit the surrounding forest is coming to an end. (Thriller, Mystery, Drama) - 2004

fxm.us.title: All About Eve
fxm.us.description: Backstage story revolving around aspiring actress Eve Harrington. Tattered and forlorn, Eve shows up in the dressing room of Broadway mega-star Margo Channing, telling a melancholy life story to Margo and her friends. Margo takes Eve under her wing, and it appears that Eve is a conniver that uses Margo. (Drama) - 1950

fxm.us.title: Bigger Than Life
fxm.us.description: After schoolteacher Ed Avery (James Mason) faints and is hospitalized, doctors diagnose him with a fatal arterial illness and tell him he has a few months to live. Ed agrees to an experimental treatment with cortisone, and makes what appears to be a miraculous recovery. However, upon his return home, his wife, Lou (Barbara Rush), notices severe mood shifts in him. His friend and coworker Wally (Walter Matthau) also perceives the changes, and discovers that Ed has been abusing the cortisone. (Drama) - 1956

fxm.us.title: Where the Sidewalk Ends
fxm.us.description: Ashamed that his father lived a life of crime, hard-boiled New York City cop Mark Dixon has a reputation for being too tough on criminals. So when Dixon unintentionally kills a murder suspect during a routine questioning, he hides the fact from the department and tries to pin the killing on his nemesis, notorious gangster Scalise. The snag in the cop's plan comes when his boss wrongly accuses the father of Dixon's love interest, Morgan, of the murder. (Crime drama) - 1950

fxm.us.title: Black Widow
fxm.us.description: At a party, Broadway producer Peter Denver (Van Heflin) meets Nancy Ordway (Peggy Ann Garner), a young writer struggling to make it in New York City. Taking pity on her, Denver offers Nancy his apartment as a place to write while his wife, Iris (Gene Tierney), is away. Shortly after, Nancy is found dead in his bathroom, apparently murdered, and Denver is, of course, the main suspect. As rumors swirl about his involvement with Nancy, Denver decides to search for her killer himself. (Mystery) - 1954

fxm.us.title: The Innocents
fxm.us.description: Based on the Henry James story "The Turn of the Screw," a psychological thriller about a woman who takes a governess job for two orphans in a Victorian home. She begins to see what she believes are ghosts and suspects the children's bizarre behavior is the result of supernatural powers. (Horror) - 1961

fxm.us.title: Hush... Hush, Sweet Charlotte
fxm.us.description: Forty years ago, on the night they were meant to elope, Charlotte Hollis (Bette Davis) found her lover decapitated during a party, the blood on her dress leading everyone to suspect she was the murderer. Now, in 1964, Charlotte is an old recluse and must fight to keep her home. She enlists the help of her cousin Velma (Olivia de Havilland), who was there at the time of the murder. However, soon after Velma's arrival, Charlotte's mind becomes unstable, and she starts seeing her dead lover's head. (Horror) - 1965

fxm.us.title: Afraid
fxm.us.description: Curtis and his family are selected to test a revolutionary new device, a digital assistant called AIA, that takes smart homes to the next level. As AIA begins to learn everyone's behavior and anticipate their needs, it soon makes sure nothing and no one gets in the family's way. (Horror, Thriller) - 2024

fxm.us.title: The Watch
fxm.us.description: In Glenview, Ohio, four pals, Evan, Bob, Franklin and Jamarcus, form a neighborhood watch group. Armed with flashlights, walkie-talkies and spiffy new jackets, the guys try to take their mission seriously, even if they spend a little time goofing off now and then. But when they discover aliens living among them and no one believes their story, they learn that they have to kick things up a notch to save the world from annihilation. (Comedy, Science fiction) - 2012

fxm.us.title: Ghostbusters
fxm.us.description: After the members of a team of scientists (Harold Ramis, Dan Aykroyd, Bill Murray) lose their cushy positions at a university in New York City, they decide to become "ghostbusters" to wage a high-tech battle with the supernatural for money. They stumble upon a gateway to another dimension, a doorway that will release evil upon the city. The Ghostbusters must now save New York from complete destruction. (Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure) - 1984

5starmax.us.title: The Man

But dentist Andy Fiddler, who's in Detroit for a conference, is there reading the same paper, and the dealer mistakes him for Vann and sets up the deal. When Vann realizes this, he drags the baffled Andy into the operation, forcing him to pose as the fake buyer. (Comedy, Action) - 2005

5starmax.us.title: Sweet Dreams
5starmax.us.description: Aspiring country singer Patsy Cline (Jessica Lange) is resigned to both her thankless gigs and her unhappy marriage, until she meets the charismatic Charlie Dick (Ed Harris). Eventually leaving her husband to marry Charlie, Patsy temporarily shelves her performing career to be a mother. Later she returns to singing and finds success under manager Randy Hughes (David Clennon). Patsy hits a remarkable stride with a string of hit singles, and has become a full-fledged star when tragedy strikes. (Biography) - 1985

5starmax.us.title: The Hangover Part II
5starmax.us.description: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, pre-wedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen. (Comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Despicable Me

(Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: The Player

(Comedy) - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Ricochet

Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
5starmax.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

bbcamerica.us.title: Criminal Minds - Self-Fulfilling Prophecy
bbcamerica.us.description: The team investigates when an apparent mass suicide takes place at a military academy; Morgan and Hotch clash. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller, Drama) - 2011-12-07

bbcamerica.us.title: Hidden Habitats - Monterey Bay
bbcamerica.us.description: A giant kelp forest hosts a diverse marine ecology in Monterey Bay, Calif., balanced by the sea otter. (Nature, Documentary) - 2014-09-23

bbcamerica.us.title: House of Wax
bbcamerica.us.description: A gang of college friends, including Wade (Jared Padalecki) and his girlfriend, Carly (Elisha Cuthbert), are en route to a school football game when they wind up with a flat tire in a ghost town. They are forced to seek help in the only place that's open: the local wax museum. Once inside the spooky and seemingly abandoned building, they find the works on display are not quite what they seem -- and the group soon discovers it's being hunted by the insane twin brothers who run the museum. (Horror) - 2005

bbcamerica.us.title: Jason X
bbcamerica.us.description: The year is 2455. The Place is Old Earth. Once the shimmering blue jewel of the galaxy, Old Earth is now a contaminated planet abandoned for centuries. Yet humans have returned to the deadly place that they once fled. Not to live, but to research the ancient rusting artifacts of the bygone civilizations that caused this environmental disaster. And little does the most recent landing party of intrepid young explorers realize the fate that awaits them. (Horror, Science fiction) - 2002

bbcamerica.us.title: Ghost Rider
bbcamerica.us.description: Years ago, motorcycle stuntman Johnny Blaze sold his soul to save the life of a loved one. Now, he transforms into a fiery, avenging agent of justice at night wherever evil roams. As the only one who can walk in both worlds, Johnny is charged by Mephistopheles himself to destroy Blackheart, a demon that wants to overthrow Mephistopheles and create a worse hell than the one that currently exists. (Action, Fantasy, Adventure, Thriller, Drama) - 2007

bbcamerica.us.title: Ghost Rider: Spirit of Vengeance
bbcamerica.us.description: Now hiding out in Eastern Europe, Johnny Blaze (Nicolas Cage) is still struggling with the curse of the Ghost Rider -- the devil's bounty hunter. Johnny meets a priest named Moreau (Idris Elba), who asks Johnny to find a boy named Danny (Fergus Riordan) and bring him back. But there's a catch -- Satan (Ciarán Hinds) is looking for the boy too, and has a personal stake in the matter. But if Johnny can find Danny first and save the boy's soul, there's a chance Johnny can save his own soul as well. (Action, Fantasy, Adventure, Thriller, Drama) - 2011

bbcamerica.us.title: Face/Off
bbcamerica.us.description: Obsessed with bringing terrorist Castor Troy (Nicolas Cage) to justice, FBI agent Sean Archer (John Travolta) tracks down Troy, who has boarded a plane in Los Angeles. After the plane crashes and Troy is severely injured, possibly dead, Archer undergoes surgery to remove his face and replace it with Troy's. As Archer tries to use his disguise to elicit information about a bomb from Troy's brother, Troy awakes from a coma and forces the doctor who performed the surgery to give him Archer's face. (Action, Crime drama) - 1997

bbcamerica.us.title: Hansel & Gretel: Witch Hunters
bbcamerica.us.description: Fifteen years after Hansel (Jeremy Renner) and Gretel (Gemma Arterton) defeated the wicked witch who planned to have them for her dinner, the siblings have come of age as skilled bounty hunters. Hell-bent on retribution, they have dedicated their lives to hunting down and destroying every witch still lurking in the dark forests of their homeland. As the notorious blood moon approaches, the siblings face a great evil -- one that could hold the secret to their terrifying past. (Fantasy, Horror, Action, Adventure) - 2013

bbcamerica.us.title: Legion

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

foodnetworkwest.us.title: Food Paradise
foodnetworkwest.us.description: There is, of course, much more to a vacation experience than hotels, sightseeing and souvenirs. For a look at what is literally on the menu, Travel Channel takes a tour of the must-see eateries across the country where a one-of-a-kind dining experience can be had. There are places that serve lip-smacking pizza, tasty deli entrees, boatloads of bacon, fresh seafood, finger-licking deep-fried dishes, juicy steaks, hot-and-spicy favorites -- the list that can whet anyone's appetite goes on and on. The restaurants that Guy visits are usually well-known among locals and other people in the region. While at each location, Fieri talks to the staff as well as the customers to get their thoughts on the food. Many episodes feature eateries that are connected by a common thread, such as burgers or comfort foods. (Cooking, Travel, Reality) - 2007-04-23

hgtvwest.us.title: Sin City Rehab
hgtvwest.us.description: S02 E02 I'm Back to Change the Game Alison challenges her new partner Josh to ditch the cookie-cutter Vegas look and embrace an elevated, custom design; she brings in antique bathroom doors and pushes him to rethink the kitchen's color palette, all in hopes of maximizing their profit.

hgtvwest.us.title: Botched Homes
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E07 Rhinestone Throne Charlie and Courtney revive an outdated home with glimpses of mid-century Florida flair. On another project, a seashell-encrusted toilet is the least of Charlie and Courtney's worries about a home with serious moisture issues.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S261 E08 Georgia Coach Takes One for the Team After landing a college football head coaching job, a couple looks for a new home near campus in Carrollton, Ga.; he's focused on a modern ranch with room to host his players, but she wants a two-story Craftsman that's near the action in Atlanta.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S276 E02 Queer Eye for the High Rise Opposites attract as an accountant searching for homey vibes clashes with her frugal partner in Chicago; one doesn't want to leave the city's gay district, while the other craves high-rise glam to prove she's made it.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S279 E11 Rushing Into Things A couple engaged after 44 days looks to buy a beach house for themselves and their two daughters on Florida's Emerald Coast; she has high expectations for luxury living and is willing to pay for it, but he's more frugal and prefers to spend less.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S269 E10 Shredding for the Wedding Architecture professionals disagree on what kind of home to buy before their wedding in Nashville, Tennessee; she wants a Southern charmer that's historic, but he prefers something modern that's move-in ready.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S278 E03 Something Between a Unicorn and a Fantasy A San Diego couple is searching for a fresh start in New Jersey. He's pushing to buy an older, quirky home beside his aunt and uncle, but she refuses to settle for anything less than her modern fantasy.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: Compromise Is for Quitters A feisty young couple match wits and will as they spar over buying their first home in Dallas; he wants a midcentury with character and doesn't mind projects, but she's after a new-build that's fresh and modern.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S272 E05 Knack for Drama Sisters with a knack for drama are buying a home together in Augusta, Georgia; their first attempt at living together didn't work out, but with rent sky-high, they're now hoping that a mortgage will force them to work together.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S271 E39 Abandonment Issues in Phoenix A Phoenix native looks to move back to his hometown to be closer to family. He wants a home that's small and manageable, but his partner in Chicago plans to split his time between the two cities, and he prefers a larger place where he can host.

hgtvwest.us.title: Unsellable Houses
hgtvwest.us.description: S04 E03 Color Confusion to Simple Oasis A homeowner needs help letting go of her colorful home of 25 years; the renovation is a real challenge for Lyndsay and Leslie as they look to transform the color cacophony and convoluted layout into a clean and simple oasis.

hgtvwest.us.title: Unsellable Houses
hgtvwest.us.description: S05 E11 Worst House Gains Big Equity Lyndsay and Leslie help a young couple get a major return on their investment for their new midcentury modern home.

hgtvwest.us.title: Unsellable Houses
hgtvwest.us.description: S05 E02 Five Days to List A widow and her son need help to give their 14-room Victorian farmhouse a more broad appeal. Over the course of only five days, Lyndsay and Leslie transform their uniquely personalized home into a marketable property.

hgtvwest.us.title: Sin City Rehab
hgtvwest.us.description: S02 E01 The Future of Kitchen Design A flashy Vegas realtor has big expectations for a dream kitchen that looks nothing like anything traditional, but when the homeowner's scammed out of his custom cabinets, the entire project nearly falls apart.

hgtvwest.us.title: Sin City Rehab
hgtvwest.us.description: S02 E02 I'm Back to Change the Game Alison challenges her new partner Josh to ditch the cookie-cutter Vegas look and embrace an elevated, custom design; she brings in antique bathroom doors and pushes him to rethink the kitchen's color palette, all in hopes of maximizing their profit.

hgtvwest.us.title: Renovation Aloha
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E01 There's a Tree Growing Through the Roof! Kamohai and Tristyn track down the owners of a home that's been abandoned for 20 years and purchase it; the house is in a great location but in rough shape with a tree growing through the roof.

hgtvwest.us.title: Renovation Aloha
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E04 Restoring the Block Kamohai and Tristyn buy their third house on the same block in Kamohai's hometown of Kaneohe; the house is in bad shape; it takes all of their skills to successfully pull off a transformation.

hgtvwest.us.title: Renovation Aloha
hgtvwest.us.description: S02 E10 Termites, Squatters and Freeways After a year-long wait, Kamohai and Tristyn face a nightmare after squatters have taken over a property in Waipahu, causing chaos and delays; with a freeway nearby, Tristyn also faces the challenge of designing soundproofing solutions.

hgtvwest.us.title: Renovation Aloha
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E07 Mango Money Pit In island real estate, speed can win the deal, but it can also backfire; when Kamohai and Tristyn rush to buy a Kaimuki fixer, huge mango trees, unreliable contractors, and spiraling costs threaten to turn a six-figure profit into a money pit.

hgtvwest.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt
hgtvwest.us.description: S24 E01 Leaving Atlanta for a Life on the Beach A family of three is eager to move to sunny Pensacola Beach, Fla., and goes hunt for the perfect waterfront home.

hgtvwest.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt
hgtvwest.us.description: S25 E01 Working for the Weekend in St. Pete Beach, Florida Hardworking best friends and coworkers search for a home to relax on the weekends in sunny St. Pete Beach, Fla.

hgtvwest.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt
hgtvwest.us.description: S25 E02 Dreaming of a Gulf-Front Gem A couple from Houston, Texas, wants to buy the beach home they've always dreamed of, and they hope to find an affordable property in nearby Surfside Beach, Texas.

hgtvwest.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt
hgtvwest.us.description: S25 E03 Looking for a Beachfront Legacy in Gulf Shores After two years of vacation rentals, a family of five is ready to purchase a beach house in Gulf Shores, Ala.

hgtvwest.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt
hgtvwest.us.description: S25 E10 Searching for a Monster Deal on the Wicked Awesome Jersey Shore A couple from Bethlehem, Pennsylvania want a waterfront home near the beaches of Wildwood, New Jersey.

hgtvwest.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt
hgtvwest.us.description: S26 E09 Ocean City Bound With a Baby A couple who met as teenagers in Ocean City, New Jersey, have always dreamed of having a vacation home there and with a baby on the way, they need to find a place before their little bundle is born.

hgtvwest.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt
hgtvwest.us.description: S27 E04 Biking to a Bargain With their kids getting older, Jodi and Sean are ready to invest in a vacation home on Hilton Head Island.

hgtvwest.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt
hgtvwest.us.description: S29 E03 Shopping for a Surfside Deal Zach and Stephanie's eleventh move brings them to the small Texan town of Surfside Beach, but before they can dig their toes into the sand, they'll need to find a property listed for an affordable price.

hgtvwest.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt
hgtvwest.us.description: S30 E12 The Artist's Way Along The Bay A professional artist couple looks to fulfill their dream of finding a home along the pristine shores of Barnegat Bay, N.J.; with inventory decreasing along the coast, they're eager to find the perfect beach house to welcome peace and inspiration.

hgtvwest.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt
hgtvwest.us.description: S30 E04 Beach Bound and Down for a Deal A recently engaged couple look to trade their busy city life for a home in the coastal resort town of Carolina Beach; they may not agree on what they want in a new beach house, but in North Carolina's hot market, time is a luxury they can't afford.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S198 E04 Nobody Puts Baby in a Corner in Mexico City After starting remote hospitality companies, new parents yearn for city-life resources near family in Mexico City; he doesn't mind spending for the ease of a place that's move-in ready, but she's concerned about cash flow and wants to stay in budget.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S202 E05 Nomads Living the Dream in Valencia, Spain After traveling the world together, a young Texan couple is ready to return to where they first met in Spain; they're looking for an apartment in Valencia with lots of natural light.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International ᴺᵉʷ
hgtvwest.us.description: S212 E09 Roots or Bust in Sicily and Ireland Chasing heritage in Ireland and Italy, families soon learn that rediscovering the past can come at a steep price in the present.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International ᴺᵉʷ
hgtvwest.us.description: S210 E09 Gloom to Glee on the Sunshine Coast After meeting in Australia, an English couple returns with their kids to the Sunshine Coast. She's looking for a place where she can walk to the beach and the kids want a pool, but their value-minded dad prefers low maintenance and high value.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S200 E11 Teaching Abroad Is No Vacation in Heilbronn Having lived abroad and traveling Europe as a child, a husband wants to show his wife the way of life in Heilbronn, Germany; he's looking for a place with great views no matter the cost; she's the sole bread winner and has more practical concerns.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S208 E15 Trading Freeways for a Fresh Start in Valencia After years of chasing the American dream in California, a couple reset their lives in Valencia, Spain. They're looking for Spanish charm with modern amenities, but finding the right place that's in their budget may be a challenge.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters International
hgtvwest.us.description: S200 E08 Childhood Playmates Take Job Transfer to Amsterdam A job offer has these once childhood playmates leaving New Jersey to fulfill a dream of living abroad in Amsterdam; they're looking for a home suitable for their daughter and aging dog.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Shock
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E01 A Reno She Never Saw Coming After living with her mom to save for their first home, a husband's out to plan a hidden renovation for his unsuspecting wife; now, Arielle and Steve are tasked to secretly transform a kitchen, living room and dining room without getting caught!

hgtvwest.us.title: Old Home Revival
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E01 Old Home Revival Gregory Storm doesn't just flip houses, he creates works of art. Restoring soul to neglected properties, he brings in buyers during renovation and customizes his innovative designs to create their perfect home.

hgtvwest.us.title: Don't Hate Your House With the Property Brothers
hgtvwest.us.description: S02 E06 Privacy Please After moving over six times in a dozen years, Carolyn and her daughters Tuki and Ruby find a house in a great neighborhood, but it has a problem - it only has two bedrooms.

hgtvwest.us.title: Don't Hate Your House With the Property Brothers
hgtvwest.us.description: S02 E02 Sibling Stress A couple's two-bedroom house made sense years ago, but now, sharing a room is causing sibling stress for their son and daughter; Jonathan and Drew look to add a bedroom without losing communal space, all while updating their kitchen and living room.

hgtvwest.us.title: Don't Hate Your House With the Property Brothers
hgtvwest.us.description: S02 E05 It's All in Play Yosemite and Charlie bought their house three years ago with the dream of being the entertainment hub for their friends; they love having their friends over for games nights and dinners.

hgtvwest.us.title: Botched Homes
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E02 Too Many Cooks Charlie helps four young musicians struggling with one dysfunctional kitchen; Courtney designs a new layout for their eclectic style and tight budget and on another project, Charlie tackles a carpeted bathroom that resembles a golf course.

hgtvwest.us.title: Botched Homes
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E03 Ratastrophe Charlie and Courtney tackle a kitchen and living room for a woman who inherited her sister's home, along with its rats and mold issues; ending a cycle of negligent contractors, the team works tirelessly to deliver the desperate renovation she needs.

hgtvwest.us.title: Botched Homes
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E05 Bathroom of the Misfit Tub Charlie and Courtney transform a primary suite for a couple whose bathroom is falling apart; after a history of wayward contractors, they put their faith in Charlie to battle termites, mold and floating rafters to bring their dream retreat to life.

hgtvwest.us.title: Ugliest House in America
hgtvwest.us.description: S08 E04 An Ugly Mess in the Midwest Retta's journey to find ugly continues in the Midwest where four homes duke it out for a chance at a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria; it includes a zombie doomsday castle, a flamingo-adorned lair and a textured carpeted dwelling.

hgtvwest.us.title: Ugliest House in America
hgtvwest.us.description: S08 E05 The Hideous Heartland The journey to find ugly continues in the Heartland where four homes battle for a chance at a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria; it includes a powder blue art deco disaster, a condo overrun by artwork and an old colorful mansion.

hgtvwest.us.title: Ugliest House in America
hgtvwest.us.description: S08 E06 The Ultimate Ugly Renovation After a season-long search, Retta reveals the Ugliest House in America! Now, designer Alison Victoria faces her ultimate renovation challenge as she turns the winning home into a true showstopper with a stunning $150,000 makeover.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S14 E08 Living Large in Lubbock Thanks to an inheritance, a longtime Georgia resident has the chance to buy a large family home closer to her grown-up children in Lubbock, Texas; David shows her some beautiful, spacious places where the houses are big, but the prices are small.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S18 E17 Must Love Michigan A couple meet and married in New York City, but decide to move to Birmingham after they have kids; David helps them find an upgrade from their small Tudor to the family friendly suburbs of Bloomfield Hills, Mich.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S15 E05 Million Dollar Start A North Carolina local receives the present of winning a million dollars just before his 27th birthday; David steps in to help him discover some homes south of Raleigh, N.C., along with shopping and design tips to help him decide.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S14 E10 Memphis Family Ties First cousins and BFFs grew up like sisters, so when one gets the chance to buy a family home, the other gets a room of her own and a bathtub; on David's first trip to Memphis, and he searches for the grand, sprawling house of their dreams.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S16 E01 Tappahannock Is for Lovers A couple met as he was recovering from a devastating injury, and now with a big lottery win, they're ready to find a dream home in Tappahannock, Va; they want a quiet, small-town life, so David sets out to find the perfect country home.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S12 E04 Million Dollar Angel When a selfless Massachusetts woman and family caretaker wins $2 million, it means a brighter future for the whole household; David takes her on an adventure through Plymouth, as they encounter cranberry bogs, historic homes, and farmyard animals.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S13 E05 Winter Wonderland A man finally scores a $1 million jackpot win on a scratcher after playing the lotto regularly for more than 20 years; winter sports are his favorite hobbies; David is tasked to help find a mountain getaway on Moosehead Lake in Greenville, Maine.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S18 E13 Moms, Best Friends and Helping Hands After a million lottery win, a mother can now help her eldest daughter buy a starter home.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S16 E11 Happy Dance in Tennessee Previous $1 million winners call on David to help find a second dream home near Nashville; they're looking for a picturesque place that's quiet and close to family, but the hardest part is deciding on a house while performing their happy dance.

hgtvwest.us.title: My Lottery Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S14 E02 Anything You Want in Vermont After receiving a family inheritance, ex-Long Island residents now see an opportunity to buy a property in their much-loved Vermont; David steps in and finds character-filled homes full of variety and charm in the breathtaking mountain landscape.

metvplus.us.title: Baywatch
metvplus.us.description: Lt. Mitch Buchannon is the dedicated leader of a group of lifeguards at Malibu Beach in Los Angeles. Although this prime-time soap opera features a lot of sand, sun and bikinis, it also tackles many serious themes and features multifaceted characters. "Baywatch" is known for using slow motion when the lifeguards are running. (Drama, Action) - 1989-09-22

metvplus.us.title: Remington Steele
metvplus.us.description: Laura Holt gets no respect as a private investigator, so she makes up a fictitious boss named Remington Steele - and business starts flowing in. The only problem is a dashing and mysterious thief who assumes the Remington Steele identity and who, surprisingly, is really good as a P.I. - especially when paired with Holt. (Crime drama) - 1982-10-01

metvplus.us.title: Hardcastle & McCormick
metvplus.us.description: A retired judge works with his last defendant to follow up on cases that were dismissed due to technicalities. (Crime drama, Adventure, Action) - 1983-09-18

metvplus.us.title: T.J. Hooker
metvplus.us.description: It's Captain Kirk! Uh, actually, it's William Shatner as Sgt. T.J. Hooker. This time he's a former detective who demotes himself to street patrol, where he feels he is needed. Assigned to the Academy Precinct of the police department, Hooker teaches rookies. With rookies like Stacy Sheridan and Vince Romano, Capt. Kirk, er, Sgt. Hooker has a pretty good team on his hands. (Crime drama) - 1982-03-13

metvplus.us.title: S.W.A.T.
metvplus.us.description: The Olympic SWAT team, a newly formed special unit, strives to overcome challenges and solve dangerous criminal cases. (Crime drama) - 1975-02-24

metvplus.us.title: Mod Squad
metvplus.us.description: Police Capt. Adam Greer recruits a trio of "hippie cops" with checkered pasts to infiltrate the counterculture and nail the adult criminals preying on clueless young Southern Californians. This "youth squad" is made up of Pete, whose wealthy parents kicked him out of their posh Beverly Hills home; Linc, a survivor of the ghetto; and Julie, a former hooker arrested for vagrancy. (Crime drama) - 1968-09-24

metvplus.us.title: The Rookies
metvplus.us.description: Three rookie cops adjust to life in Southern California. (Crime drama) - 1972-09-11

metvplus.us.title: The Streets of San Francisco
metvplus.us.description: Traditionalist veteran cop Lt. Mike Stone is partnered with Inspector Steve Keller, a young, inexperienced college-educated go-getter in the homicide division of the San Francisco Police Department. The two enjoy a bantering relationship while they hunt down the bad guys as Stone teaches Keller the ropes. (Crime drama) - 1972-09-16

metvplus.us.title: Hawaii Five-O
metvplus.us.description: Detective Steve McGarrett (Jack Lord) heads up Hawaii Five-O, a special division of the state police tasked with bringing down organized crime on the islands. The Five-O team works with local police from time to time on individual cases, and McGarrett's nemesis is crime kingpin Wo Fat. The show, which ran for 12 seasons during its original run, is famous for its catchphrase "Book 'em, Danno," said by McGarrett at the end of most episodes. The show's theme song, composed by Morton Stevens, became popular during the show's original run. (Crime drama) - 1968-09-20
