It all comes down to one night, 50 cars and a contract. (Action, Thriller) - 2000

fxwest.us.title: Predator
fxwest.us.description: Dutch, a soldier of fortune, is hired by the U.S. government to secretly rescue a group of politicians trapped in Guatemala. But when Dutch and his team, which includes weapons expert Blain and CIA agent George, land in Central America, something is wrong. After finding a string of dead bodies, the crew discovers they are being hunted by a brutal creature with superhuman strength and the ability to disappear into its surroundings. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 1987

fxwest.us.title: Poltergeist
fxwest.us.description: All seems well for Eric Bowen (Sam Rockwell), wife Amy (Rosemarie DeWitt) and their three children as they move into their new house in the suburbs of Illinois. Soon, the youngest daughter Maddy (Kennedi Clements) begins talking to an imaginary friend, or so the family thinks. It's not long before sinister spirits wreak havoc in the home, holding Maddy captive and forcing the parents to consult a team of parapsychologists who engage the supernatural entities in a battle for the girl's freedom. (Horror, Thriller) - 2015

fxwest.us.title: Alien 3
fxwest.us.description: Ellen Ripley (Sigourney Weaver) is the only survivor when she crash lands on Fiorina 161, a bleak wasteland inhabited by former inmates of the planet's maximum security prison. Once again, Ripley must face skepticism and the alien as it hunts down the prisoners and guards. Without weapons or modern technology of any kind, Ripley leads the men into battle against the terrifying creature. (Science fiction, Horror) - 1992

fxwest.us.title: Aliens vs. Predator: Requiem
fxwest.us.description: Residents (Steven Pasquale, Reiko Aylesworth, John Ortiz) of Gunnison, Colorado, are caught up in the crossfire when two deadly extraterrestrial species bring their longstanding conflict to Earth. On the one side, nearly indestructible Aliens; on the other, a lone Predator whose mission is to wipe out all traces of the Alien infestation from Earth, no matter who gets in the way. (Science fiction, Horror, Thriller, Action) - 2007

fxwest.us.title: The Sixth Sense
fxwest.us.description: Young Cole Sear (Haley Joel Osment) is haunted by a dark secret: he is visited by ghosts. Cole is frightened by visitations from those with unresolved problems who appear from the shadows. He is too afraid to tell anyone about his anguish, except child psychologist Dr. Malcolm Crowe (Bruce Willis). As Dr. Crowe tries to uncover the truth about Cole's supernatural abilities, the consequences for client and therapist are a jolt that awakens them both to something unexplainable. (Thriller, Mystery, Action, Horror) - 1999

fxwest.us.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
fxwest.us.description: Eddie Brock is still struggling to coexist with the shape-shifting extraterrestrial Venom. When deranged serial killer Cletus Kasady also becomes host to an alien symbiote, Brock and Venom must put aside their differences to stop his reign of terror. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction, Comedy) - 2021

fxwest.us.title: Ghostbusters
fxwest.us.description: Paranormal researcher Abby Yates and physicist Erin Gilbert are trying to prove that ghosts exist in modern society. When strange apparitions appear in Manhattan, Gilbert and Yates turn to engineer Jillian Holtzmann for help. Also joining the team is Patty Tolan, a lifelong New Yorker who knows the city inside and out. Armed with proton packs and plenty of attitude, the four women prepare for an epic battle as more than 1,000 mischievous ghouls descend on Times Square. (Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure, Action) - 2016

fxwest.us.title: Star Wars: The Phantom Menace
fxwest.us.description: Obi-Wan Kenobi (Ewan McGregor) is a young apprentice Jedi knight under the tutelage of Qui-Gon Jinn (Liam Neeson) ; Anakin Skywalker (Jake Lloyd), who will later father Luke Skywalker and become known as Darth Vader, is just a 9-year-old boy. When the Trade Federation cuts off all routes to the planet Naboo, Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan are assigned to settle the matter. (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 1999

fxwest.us.title: Star Wars: Attack of the Clones
fxwest.us.description: Set ten years after the events of "The Phantom Menace," the Republic continues to be mired in strife and chaos. A separatist movement encompassing hundreds of planets and powerful corporate alliances poses new threats to the galaxy that even the Jedi cannot stem. These moves, long planned by an as yet unrevealed and powerful force, lead to the beginning of the Clone Wars -- and the beginning of the end of the Republic. (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2002

fxwest.us.title: Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith
fxwest.us.description: It has been three years since the Clone Wars began. Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi (Ewan McGregor) and Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker (Hayden Christensen) rescue Chancellor Palpatine (Ian McDiarmid) from General Grievous, the commander of the droid armies, but Grievous escapes. Suspicions are raised within the Jedi Council concerning Chancellor Palpatine, with whom Anakin has formed a bond. Asked to spy on the chancellor, and full of bitterness toward the Jedi Council, Anakin embraces the Dark Side. (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2005

fxwest.us.title: Star Wars: A New Hope
fxwest.us.description: The Imperial Forces -- under orders from cruel Darth Vader (David Prowse) -- hold Princess Leia (Carrie Fisher) hostage, in their efforts to quell the rebellion against the Galactic Empire. Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill) and Han Solo (Harrison Ford), captain of the Millennium Falcon, work together with the companionable droid duo R2-D2 (Kenny Baker) and C-3PO (Anthony Daniels) to rescue the beautiful princess, help the Rebel Alliance, and restore freedom and justice to the Galaxy. (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 1977

retroplex.us.title: Hemingway's Garden of Eden
retroplex.us.description: During an extended honeymoon in Europe, a restless wife (Mena Suvari) tests her husband's (Jack Huston) devotion by inviting a sultry Italian woman into their inner circle. (Drama, Romance) - 2008

retroplex.us.title: Back to the Secret Garden
retroplex.us.description: Camilla Belle stars as Lizzie Buscana, a spirited orphan girl, in this sequel to the beloved adaptation of Frances Hodgson Burnett's novel. Lady Mary Craven, the original heroine, now an adult, befriends Lizzie and invites her to move from Brooklyn to Misselthwaite Manor, which is now an orphanage. After hearing about the secret garden, Lizzie is disappointed upon arriving to find it in a state of decay, and she endeavors to restore the garden to its past splendor. (Children, Fantasy, Drama) - 2000

retroplex.us.title: Niagara Niagara
retroplex.us.description: Two misfits (Robin Tunney, Henry Thomas) meet while shoplifting and set out on a mission that takes a quick downward spiral. (Drama) - 1997

retroplex.us.title: Riders of Destiny
retroplex.us.description: Loner government agent Singin' Sandy Saunders (John Wayne) witnesses what seems to be a stagecoach robbery, committed by young Fay Denton (Cecelia Parker). But Fay is actually just trying to get her hands back on her own money in order to keep it from thieving stooges Bert (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) and Elmer (Heinie Conklin) and their boss, local land grabber James Kincaid (Forrest Taylor). Saunders then teams up with Kay to fight off the gang and derail the criminal plots of the greedy Kincaid. (Western) - 1933

retroplex.us.title: Rough Riders' Round-Up
retroplex.us.description: Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) and a couple of his Rough Rider buddies -- Rusty (Raymond Hatton) and Tommy (Eddie Acuff) -- join the Border Patrol. First, they successfully find missing young woman Dorothy Blair (Mary Hart). They then try to track down bandit Arizona Jack (William Pawley). During the chase, Tommy is killed by Jack, and Roy and Rusty decide to cross the border into Mexico to find the outlaw. But Jack has plenty of reinforcements waiting, and Roy and Rusty may be in over their heads. (Western) - 1939

retroplex.us.title: Down Missouri Way
retroplex.us.description: In this musical, agriculture professor Jane Colwell (Martha O'Driscoll) is seeking a quiet getaway when she takes her prized mule off to visit an Ozarks farming community. But upon arrival she is stunned to discover a film crew diligently at work on a new movie. Soon, Jane and her mule companion are swept up in the filmmaking frenzy. While the photogenic mule upstages the production's human star (Renee Godfrey), Jane finds herself falling for the feature's dashing producer (William Wright). (Musical comedy) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Susanna Pass
retroplex.us.description: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Driftin' River
retroplex.us.description: The cavalry asks cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) to inspect 300 horses they're looking to purchase from J.C. Morgan (Shirley Patterson), to assist the Army in battling outlaw attacks on railroad construction workers. Eddie and friend Soapy (Roscoe Ates) visit J.C.'s ranch, unaware that the attacks are being conducted by outlaw Marino (Dennis Moore), who owns the town saloon. Fearing the rail expansion will end his stage business, Marino attacks J.C.'s horses, and she turns to Eddie for help. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Pit Pony
retroplex.us.description: A horse's companionship helps a boy overcome his fears and work in a Nova Scotia coal mine to support his family. (Drama) - 1997

retroplex.us.title: Stage to Mesa City
retroplex.us.description: Valiant U.S. Marshal Cheyenne Davis (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his trusty deputy, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are on their way to aid a stagecoach owner who is mired in financial burdens. But, when they arrive and discover he's been murdered, the loyal pair are asked by Margie (Jennifer Holt), his daughter, to seek out his killers and make them pay for their vile crime. The investigation soon leads them to a sneering lawyer (Marshall Reed), who has a mysterious boss. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Stagecoach Outlaws
retroplex.us.description: Cowboy Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) enrages saloon owner Steve Kirby (Stanford Jolley) when he thwarts a bank robbery by Kirby's crew. But Kirby has more schemes up his sleeve. He sends his men to bust brutish outlaw Matt Brawley (Bob Kortman) out of jail for a new heist. When a case of mistaken identities leads to the bandits freeing harmless Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) instead, he decides to play along to help Billy. However, the real Brawley soon arrives to cause trouble. (Western) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: Blue Steel
retroplex.us.description: Undercover federal marshal John Carruthers (John Wayne) is suspected by the local sheriff, Jake (George Hayes), of stealing the town's payroll, but his suspicions are sidelined when young Betty Mason (Eleanor Hunt) announces that her father, an important businessman, has been murdered. Without him, supplies will not reach town, and homesteaders will starve. When town leader Malgrove (Edward Peil) offers to buy the locals out, John and Jake get suspicious, and uncover a land-grabbing conspiracy. (Western) - 1934

retroplex.us.title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
retroplex.us.description: Django believes there is only one path for him to follow when he returns to his hometown and discovers his father has been murdered by a ruthless gang. (Action, Western) - 1967

retroplex.us.title: Oklahoma Annie
retroplex.us.description: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day. (Western, Comedy) - 1952

retroplex.us.title: Stagecoach Outlaws
retroplex.us.description: Cowboy Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) enrages saloon owner Steve Kirby (Stanford Jolley) when he thwarts a bank robbery by Kirby's crew. But Kirby has more schemes up his sleeve. He sends his men to bust brutish outlaw Matt Brawley (Bob Kortman) out of jail for a new heist. When a case of mistaken identities leads to the bandits freeing harmless Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) instead, he decides to play along to help Billy. However, the real Brawley soon arrives to cause trouble. (Western) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: Stage to Mesa City
retroplex.us.description: Valiant U.S. Marshal Cheyenne Davis (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his trusty deputy, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are on their way to aid a stagecoach owner who is mired in financial burdens. But, when they arrive and discover he's been murdered, the loyal pair are asked by Margie (Jennifer Holt), his daughter, to seek out his killers and make them pay for their vile crime. The investigation soon leads them to a sneering lawyer (Marshall Reed), who has a mysterious boss. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Lightning Raiders
retroplex.us.description: When his mail doesn't get delivered one day, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) is suspicious. He enlists the help of his friend Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) to find out what happened. The duo discovers that the postal stagecoach has been held up by Frank Hayden (Steve Darrell) and his band of thieves, and that the criminals are in hiding. It's up to Fuzzy and Billy to stop the thieves before they make off with the stolen mail -- and with the money and secrets that it contains. (Western) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: Riders of Destiny
retroplex.us.description: Loner government agent Singin' Sandy Saunders (John Wayne) witnesses what seems to be a stagecoach robbery, committed by young Fay Denton (Cecelia Parker). But Fay is actually just trying to get her hands back on her own money in order to keep it from thieving stooges Bert (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) and Elmer (Heinie Conklin) and their boss, local land grabber James Kincaid (Forrest Taylor). Saunders then teams up with Kay to fight off the gang and derail the criminal plots of the greedy Kincaid. (Western) - 1933

retroplex.us.title: Colorado
retroplex.us.description: Lieutenant Jerry Burke (Roy Rogers) is sent to Colorado to track down a troublesome gang. When he finally catches them, he finds out his traitorous brother commands them. (Western) - 1940

retroplex.us.title: Rough Riders' Round-Up
retroplex.us.description: Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) and a couple of his Rough Rider buddies -- Rusty (Raymond Hatton) and Tommy (Eddie Acuff) -- join the Border Patrol. First, they successfully find missing young woman Dorothy Blair (Mary Hart). They then try to track down bandit Arizona Jack (William Pawley). During the chase, Tommy is killed by Jack, and Roy and Rusty decide to cross the border into Mexico to find the outlaw. But Jack has plenty of reinforcements waiting, and Roy and Rusty may be in over their heads. (Western) - 1939

retroplex.us.title: In Old Caliente
retroplex.us.description: In California, Roy (Roy Rogers) works on the large ranch of Don Jose (Frank Puglia), one of the last of the major Spanish landowners. The foreman of the ranch, Saguaro (Jack LaRue), is involved with a gang of bandits and hopes to pit the newly arriving Americans against the dwindling Spanish and native populations. Saguaro becomes Roy's nemesis, getting him banished from the ranch and framing him for various crimes, but Roy concocts an audacious plan to clear his name. (Western) - 1939

retroplex.us.title: Susanna Pass
retroplex.us.description: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: The Carson City Kid
retroplex.us.description: The Carson City Kid (Roy Rogers) stops stagecoaches traveling between Wild West mining towns, searching their mail sacks for letters addressed to Morgan Reynolds, the man who killed his brother. Discovering that Reynolds operates a saloon under the name Lee Jessup (Bob Steele), the Kid takes a job as the saloon's bouncer. While vying with Reynolds for the affections of singer Joby Madison (Pauline Moore), the Kid discovers a swindled miner (Noah Beery Jr.) who claims to be the Carson City Kid. (Western) - 1940

retroplex.us.title: Driftin' River
retroplex.us.description: The cavalry asks cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) to inspect 300 horses they're looking to purchase from J.C. Morgan (Shirley Patterson), to assist the Army in battling outlaw attacks on railroad construction workers. Eddie and friend Soapy (Roscoe Ates) visit J.C.'s ranch, unaware that the attacks are being conducted by outlaw Marino (Dennis Moore), who owns the town saloon. Fearing the rail expansion will end his stage business, Marino attacks J.C.'s horses, and she turns to Eddie for help. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Lights of Old Santa Fe
retroplex.us.description: In this musical western, Marjorie Brooks (Dale Evans) is the owner and operator of a rodeo that's an antiquated touring company on its last legs. Her business rival, Frank Madden (Richard Powers), offers to combine their operations if the lovely Marjorie will be his bride. Though she initially rebuffs his proposal, a canceled booking tips the scales and forces Marjorie to accept. But rodeo rider Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) suspects Frank is behind Marjorie's troubles and sets out to investigate. (Western) - 1944

retroplex.us.description: Things go from bad to worse for singing cowboy Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) and his trusty companion, Teddy Bear (Guinn "Big Boy" Williams), when, after losing their jobs at a local café, the pair are accused of having kidnapped young Chip Williams (Mary Lee) who, in reality, is merely a runaway who's been tagging along with the cowpokes. But amidst these problems, Roy and his partner decide to team up with the girl and her half-sister, Ysobel (Dale Evans), and search for some long-buried treasure. (Western) - 1944

retroplex.us.title: Blue Steel
retroplex.us.description: Undercover federal marshal John Carruthers (John Wayne) is suspected by the local sheriff, Jake (George Hayes), of stealing the town's payroll, but his suspicions are sidelined when young Betty Mason (Eleanor Hunt) announces that her father, an important businessman, has been murdered. Without him, supplies will not reach town, and homesteaders will starve. When town leader Malgrove (Edward Peil) offers to buy the locals out, John and Jake get suspicious, and uncover a land-grabbing conspiracy. (Western) - 1934

retroplex.us.title: Tucker: The Man and His Dream
retroplex.us.description: Obsessed with cars since childhood, inventor Preston Tucker (Jeff Bridges) has his first successful auto design partnership in the 1930s and designs a successful gun turret for World War II use. With those achievements under his belt, Tucker is determined to create a futuristic car for the masses: the Tucker Torpedo. However, his dreams are challenged by Detroit's auto manufacturers, production problems and accusations of stock fraud, and he is forced to defend his dream and honesty in court. (Biography, Historical drama) - 1988

retroplex.us.title: Live!
retroplex.us.description: Documentarian Rex (David Krumholtz) follows ruthless reality television producer Katy Courbet (Eva Mendes), a woman who will stop at nothing to revive the American Broadcasting Network's failing ratings -- and forward her own career. To the dismay of the government, Courbet approves a reality show that will become network television's first foray into snuff. showtimewest.us.title: Troy
showtimewest.us.description: While visiting Spartan King Menelaus, Trojan prince Paris falls for Menelaus' wife, Helen and takes her back to Troy. Menelaus' brother, King Agamemnon uses his brother's fury as a pretext to declare war against Troy.

showtimewest.us.title: Pulp Fiction
showtimewest.us.description: Two hit men (John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson), a boxer, a crime boss and others meet their fates over the course of two days.

showtimewest.us.title: Ask the Dust
showtimewest.us.description: In Depression-era Los Angeles, a fiery Mexican waitress (Salma Hayek) who wants to improve her lot through marriage meets an aspiring writer (Colin Farrell) of Italian descent.

showtimewest.us.title: Noah
showtimewest.us.description: God chooses Noah (Russell Crowe) to build an ark and save the animals and his family from an apocalyptic flood.

showtimewest.us.title: The Lovely Bones
showtimewest.us.description: A 14-year-old murder victim watches from heaven, as her family tries to heal and her killer continues on his own dark path.

showtimewest.us.title: Failure to Launch
showtimewest.us.description: The parents of a young man (Matthew McConaughey) who still lives at home hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to finally leave the nest.

showtimewest.us.title: The Intern
showtimewest.us.description: Dissatisfied with retirement, a 70-year-old widower becomes an intern at an online fashion site and develops a special bond with his young boss.

showtimewest.us.title: Homestead
showtimewest.us.description: A former green beret and other survivors take refuge inside an elaborate compound when an attack on America leaves the world in chaos.

showtimewest.us.title: Se7en
showtimewest.us.description: A meticulous detective and the young officer about to replace the veteran probe serial murders based on the seven deadly sins.

showtimewest.us.title: Shell
showtimewest.us.description: Desperate to reclaim her career, once-beloved actress Samantha Lake gets drawn into the glamorous world of wellness mogul Zoe Shannon, only to uncover a monstrous truth beneath the seemingly flawless surface.

showtimewest.us.title: Parasite
showtimewest.us.description: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.

showtimewest.us.title: Argo
showtimewest.us.description: During the Iran hostage crisis, an extraction specialist (Ben Affleck) in the CIA poses as a Hollywood film producer to rescue six Americans who eluded Iranian militants and found refuge with the Canadian ambassador.

showtimewest.us.title: Lust or Marriage
showtimewest.us.description: Khloe unexpectedly develops feelings towards her mother's soon-to-be husband. As her boyfriend becomes suspicious and begins to do his own investigation, complications arise - and a larger game is discovered.

showtimewest.us.title: The Wedding Banquet
showtimewest.us.description: Hoping to stay in the country, a gay man proposes a green card marriage to a female friend in exchange for paying for her IVF treatment. However, things get complicated when his grandmother surprises them with an extravagant Korean wedding banquet.

showtimewest.us.title: Afflicted
showtimewest.us.description: Two friends' tour of Europe takes a dark turn when one of them contracts a mysterious illness. They race to find out what it is and how to cure it before the sickness consumes him completely.

showtimewest.us.title: The Haunting
showtimewest.us.description: A parapsychologist and three others stay in a house reputed to be the site of many awful tragedies and paranormal events.

showtimewest.us.title: The Last Exorcism Part II
showtimewest.us.description: Unable to remember the horrific events of her past, Nell Sweetzer tries to rebuild her life in New Orleans. However, a demonic force soon returns with sinister plans for her.

showtimewest.us.title: The Perfect Gamble
showtimewest.us.description: Released from prison, two gamblers get entangled with the mafia when they decide to open an illegal casino.

showtimewest.us.title: Brave the Dark
showtimewest.us.description: When Mr. Deen discovers one of his students has been living out of his car and thrown into jail, he decides to bail him out. Determined to curb Nate's self-destructive behavior, Mr. Deen discovers a host of secrets that are slowly tearing Nate apart.

showtimewest.us.title: Forrest Gump
showtimewest.us.description: JFK, LBJ, Vietnam, Watergate and other history unfold through the perspective of an Alabama man (Tom Hanks) with an IQ of 75.

showtimewest.us.title: Magic Mike
showtimewest.us.description: A male stripper takes a newcomer under his wing and instructs him in the fine arts of partying, picking up women and making plenty of money.

showtimewest.us.title: Magic Mike XXL
showtimewest.us.description: Three years after retiring from stripping, Mike Lane (Channing Tatum) reunites with the rest of the Kings of Tampa (Matt Bomer, Joe Manganiello) for one final, outrageous performance in Myrtle Beach, S.C.

showtimewest.us.title: Daddy's Home
showtimewest.us.description: An insecure man (Will Ferrell) competes for the affection of his stepchildren when their freewheeling father (Mark Wahlberg) breezes back into town.

tlcwest.us.description: The 90-Day singles hit Puerto Rico looking for love. Michael is ready for a fresh start, Chloe sets her sights on a cowboy, and Brittany takes a chance on a promising connection. Kara confronts Emma over welcome party drama before revealing a secret. (Reality) - 2026-10-05

tlcwest.us.title: 90 Day Fiancé: The Other Way - Love, Lies, and La Dolce Vita, Part 1
tlcwest.us.description: Jessy is ready to risk it all for a life in Italy; Andi has doubts about moving Down Under; Jon and Ally hide her pregnancy from her Muslim parents; Niles plans to head back to Matilda in Ghana, with secret plans in tow. (Reality, Documentary, Romance) - 2026-10-10

tlcwest.us.title: 90 Day Fiancé: The Other Way - Love, Lies, and La Dolce Vita, Part 2
tlcwest.us.description: Jessy is ready to risk it all for a life in Italy; Andi has doubts about moving Down Under; Jon and Ally hide her pregnancy from her Muslim parents; Niles plans to head back to Matilda in Ghana, with secret plans in tow. (Reality, Documentary, Romance) - 2026-10-10

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire - South Carolina Peach-Glazed Ribs with Rice Middlins
tastemade.us.description: When Pat's friends and fellow barbecue chefs, Bryan Furman and Dr. Howard Conyers, come to town, the guys dig deep into the tricks and traditions of one of Bryan's specialties: pork ribs. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire - The Roscoe Family Legacy: Alabama Pit Ribs
tastemade.us.description: Pat heads to Birmingham to team up with artist and chef Roscoe Hall, cooking ribs inspired by Roscoe's family legacy. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire - Live Fire Whole Trout
tastemade.us.description: Pat Martin heads to the Cherokee National Forest for a day of fly-fishing with an old friend, and to cook up their fresh catch over the campfire. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire - Catching Gulf Coast Redfish and Blue Crabs
tastemade.us.description: Pat visits Houston to go Gulf Bay fishing with chef Chris Shepherd, hoping to catch some redfish and gather a side of blue crabs. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire - Uncovering Houston BBQ's Asian Influences
tastemade.us.description: Pat meets the trio behind Blood Bros BBQ to discover how three childhood friends seamlessly blended their Asian-American culture with the Texas barbecue traditions they grew up with. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire - Barbecued Pork Steak
tastemade.us.description: Pat Martin travels to Gainesboro, Tennessee to visit a free-range hog farm, learn about their operations, and grill up a less desired, but no less delicious, cut of hog - pork steaks. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Pioneering From Farm to Table
tastemade.us.description: Gaby Molinar owns Huerto Urbano, an urban farm dedicated to providing Monterrey with nutritious, diverse local ingredients. And her husband is one of the region's greatest culinary pioneers. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Super Sonoran
tastemade.us.description: Pati makes three classic Sonoran recipes: a fish special called pescado zarandeado, a rich stew called gallina pinta and a tasty dirty rice with clams. In Sonora, she visits vacation destination Puerto Peñasco. (Cooking) - 2024-02-15

tastemade.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The World Cup of Tacos
tastemade.us.description: Nuevo León is divided between two pro soccer teams: Los Tigres and Los Rayados. Pati tries the food at each stadium with the teams' stars to determine who wins in the battle of tortas vs tacos. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Legends of the Sonoran Sea
tastemade.us.description: Pati travels to Sonora's coast on the Sea of Cortez, where local legend Toño Contreras gives her a tour including shellfish on the beach, his restaurant Mariscos El Rey, and his home kitchen for some crave-worthy recipes. (Cooking) - 2024-02-15

tastemade.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Sonoran Family Favorites
tastemade.us.description: Pati spends a day in the kitchen with her middle son, Sami, cooking recipes inspired by her travels in Sonora that she knows he'll love - beef and potato chimichangas, rice with lentils and caramelized onions, and an avocado and radish salad. (Cooking) - 2024-02-08

tastemade.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Sisters, Stew, and Sass
tastemade.us.description: Two sisters made a little shack on the Rio Ramos into a must-visit restaurant known for one dish: cortadillo stew. Down the road, another restaurant uses traditional stews in their famous empalmes. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The Ultimate Elk Tailgate
tastemade.us.description: It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The Wild Boar Playbook
tastemade.us.description: Andrew turns wild boar into the ultimate game-day spread with boar and black bean chili topped with crisp cornbread waffles, and pulled boar sliders braised low and slow in Carolina Gold mustard sauce. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Back to Our Caveman Roots
tastemade.us.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The Most Underrated Game Bird
tastemade.us.description: Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ - Grilled Steak Salad and Italian-style Lamb Chops
tastemade.us.description: Jamie shares his perfect Steak & Chargrilled Salad, a Chicken Caesar Salad with an upgrade on the bars, Italia-inspired Sizzling Lamb Lollipops and his delicious Whole Barbecue Fish & Ratatouille to upgrade your grill skills! (Cooking) - 2026-09-01

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ - Grilled Fish Tacos and a Veggie Pancake
tastemade.us.description: For the ultimate BBQ experience, Jamie cooks a Butterflied Leg of Lamb, his Spiced Chicken Kebabs and creamy butter sauce perfect for a party, followed by Grilled Fish Tacos and Jamie's Tear 'n' Share Veggie Pancake ready to feed a crowd. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ - Sesame Chicken Burger and Surf & Turf Mixed Grill
tastemade.us.description: Jamie takes outdoor cooking to new heights with his Ultimate Barbecue Breakfast, a smoke-kissed Sesame Chicken Burger, his Veggie Barbecue Mezze offering an epic spread; and his Surf & Turf Mixed Grill is a perfect party crowd-pleaser! (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Backyard BBQ Hero - Steakhouse Hero
tastemade.us.description: Susie's bringing in a special guest so you can bring the steakhouse to your backyard! Christie Vanover of Girls Can Grill joins the fun and brings some fingerling potatoes to round out the ribeyes, asparagus, and a one-of-a-kind compound butter! (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Backyard BBQ Hero - Pulled Pork Party Hero
tastemade.us.description: It's always kind of a party in the backyard, but it's really a party when Susie breaks out the smoker for some legendary pulled pork sliders, a homemade coleslaw, and a mac and cheese so creamy even the grownups will rave about it. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Backyard BBQ Hero - Smoked Brisket Hero
tastemade.us.description: Pitmaster Jason Neeley (Pica Rica BBQ) drops by the backyard to share some insider tips for nailing the perfect brisket and helps Susie make pickled vegetables to go alongside her dad's hot potato salad! This is a must-watch for serious Pitmasters. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Backyard BBQ Hero - Mexican Carne Asada Hero
tastemade.us.description: Grill fatigue is a very real problem, but the globally-inspired menu of carne asada, tomatillo salsa, Mexican street corn, and Tex-Mex beans in this episode of Backyard BBQ Hero is sure to reignite the fire inside and get you outside cooking! (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Backyard BBQ Hero - Santa Maria Tri-tip Hero
tastemade.us.description: If you love outdoor grilling AND flexing your skills by entertaining guests, the next Backyard BBQ Hero is required viewing. Fire up the grill for a show-stopping Santa Maria-style tri tip, a zesty salad, and an unbelievable dinner bread! (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Backyard BBQ Hero - Weeknight Family Dinner Hero
tastemade.us.description: Susie from Hey Grill Hey teaches you how to make a full family dinner right in your own backyard in under 30 minutes! When you serve this grilled honey mustard chicken, creamed corn, and mixed veggies, you'll feel like a Weeknight BBQ Hero! (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire - Pit-Cooked Chicken with Alabama White Sauce
tastemade.us.description: Pat Martin travels to Decatur, Alabama to visit a storied institution of barbecue - Big Bob Gibson's. There, he learns the ins, the outs, and the history of a regional delicacy: pit-cooked chicken with Alabama white sauce. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire - Discovering Indian Lamb Kebabs in Nashville
tastemade.us.description: Pat grills riverside with renowned chef Vivek Surti, crafting lamb kofta and chicken kebabs inspired by his Indian heritage. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire - Searching for Oaxaca in Tennessee
tastemade.us.description: Pat visits Edgar Victoria, known for bringing the street foods of Mexico City to Nashville, to do some live fire cooking out in nature as they prepare one of his favorite dishes - skirt steak tlayuda. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire - Greek Spit Roast Lamb
tastemade.us.description: Pat Martin links up with his pal, Bill Darsinos, to enjoy a tradition from the heart of Bill's Greek culture when they cook a whole lamb on a spit roast. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire - Bluefin Tuna Collars with Chili Pickle Relish
tastemade.us.description: Pat Martin visits chef Adam Perry Lang in Los Angeles, where the pair cooks a prized catch castoff cut - Bluefin Tuna collars. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire - The Legend of Louis Mueller's Dino Beef Ribs
tastemade.us.description: Pat visits his close friend Wayne Mueller, third-generation pitmaster of Louis Mueller's BBQ, to learn the ins and outs of his famous dino beef ribs. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals - Peperonata Eggs on Toast and Baked Cinnamon Apples
tastemade.us.description: Jamie makes a no-cook store-cupboard olive pasta sauce, a cheap frozen-pepper peperonata stew with coddled eggs, a wallet-friendly chicken thigh and bean roast dinner, and budget-clever homemade takeaway kebabs with flatbreads! (Cooking) - 2026-07-20

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals - Easy Chicken Curry and Feta Tomato Pasta
tastemade.us.description: Jamie makes an air-fryer tomato and roast feta pasta using leftover noodles, a budget rolled carrot cake, and a cheap family chicken curry. Plus, an epic cheese-on-toast Welsh rarebit upgrade and frozen fish Chinese-inspired dough parcels! (Cooking) - 2026-07-20

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals - Better Than Takeout: Indian-Spiced Lentils
tastemade.us.description: Jamie makes frugal leftovers fun with spaghetti frittata, bakes air-fryer pork pies using affordable mince, and preps a batch of butternut squash dal. Plus, budget-friendly chicken shish kebabs and thrifty mint choc chip whoopie pies! (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The Best Fish You're Not Eating
tastemade.us.description: Andrew takes on "little fish, big fish," cooking grilled whole small fish over Japanese charcoal with sesame spinach, and a larger fish in a bold puttanesca-style dish. Simple techniques, big flavor, and a case for eating lower on the food chain. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Mediterranean Grilled Filets and Salt Crusted Halibut
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. Then, he demonstrates a classic salt-crusted whole halibut, served with whole roasted cauliflower and a rich cream sauce. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Grilled Rabbit with Panzanella Salad
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The Essence of Grill Culture
tastemade.us.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Bison Brats & Grilled Kebabs on Flatbread
tastemade.us.description: Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Making Couscous in Tunisia
tastemade.us.description: Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Traditional Greek Cuisine
tastemade.us.description: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Stunning Seafood of Marseille
tastemade.us.description: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Inspirational Spanish Tapas
tastemade.us.description: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Cauliflower Star Power
tastemade.us.description: Cauliflower can be transformed into unexpected, delicious and nutritious dishes; Frankie discusses why to buy dried-goods in bulk and makes a big chuck roast that stretches over three dishes. (Cooking) - 2018-08-23

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Too Hot To Cook
tastemade.us.description: When the temps are soaring and turning on your stove or oven is not even an option, Frankie's no cook meals will blow you away. Enjoy refreshing, nourishing dishes that will help keep you cool all summer long. (Cooking) - 2023-06-02

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Plant-Based Budget Meals
tastemade.us.description: Frankie busts the myth that eating plant-based is expensive. Preparing these good-for-you meals is all about eating seasonally to save money on produce, and shopping the bulk aisle for even more savings on plant-based pantry items. (Cooking) - 2019-07-05

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Picnic Lunches
tastemade.us.description: It's field trip day, and Frankie shows off his best handheld lunches perfect for leisurely days at the park, the beach or the pool. These sturdy meals are made to travel and only get better with time. (Cooking) - 2023-05-25

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Winter Is Here
tastemade.us.description: The struggle is real, but it doesn't mean your food has to suffer. Chef Frankie Celenza shows you how to make delicious meals that won't break the bank. (Cooking) - 2020-02-07

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Crunchy
tastemade.us.description: Reaching textural nirvana is never easy, but Frankie explores several ways to achieve the perfect crunch in his dishes, both savory and sweet. Add this elusive element to your recipes without adding cost to your budget. (Cooking) - 2021-03-26

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Warm + Cozy Winter
tastemade.us.description: Frankie gets cozy in the kitchen with recipes that bring all the warmth, flavor and joy during the coldest days of winter; from a casual weekday dinner to a special weekend meal. (Cooking) - 2021-02-05

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Bananas For Bananas
tastemade.us.description: As one of the cheapest members of the produce aisle, bananas will save you bunches of money when you whip up these delightfully appealing recipes that go above and beyond basic bread. (Cooking) - 2022-03-18

tntwest.us.title: Cold Case - One Small Step
tntwest.us.description: The team reopens the case of a murdered 12-year-old boy when a new clue is given to the retired cop who worked on the case. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 2008-11-09

tntwest.us.title: Cold Case - Triple Threat
tntwest.us.description: Lilly and the team re-examine the 1989 death of a young Russian opera singer who defected to the U.S. with her family before the fall of the Berlin Wall. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 2008-11-16

tntwest.us.title: Cold Case - Pin Up Girl
tntwest.us.description: A crime scene photo provided by a fan offers new evidence in the 1953 murder of a famous pinup girl. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 2008-11-23

tntwest.us.title: Cold Case - Street Money
tntwest.us.description: The team reopens the murder case of a young politician who promised to get rid of drug dealers preying on kids in the neighborhood he grew up in. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 2008-11-30

tntwest.us.title: Cold Case - Wings
tntwest.us.description: Rush reopens the case of a stewardess murdered in 1960 while trying to organize a union. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 2008-12-21

tntwest.us.title: Cold Case - Lotto Fever
tntwest.us.description: Rush and the team reopen the case of an auto mechanic who was murdered after winning $8 million in the state lottery; Valens discovers there might be a problem with his relationship with Frankie. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 2009-01-04

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Best Laid Plans
tntwest.us.description: When a retired FBI agent is tortured and killed while working a security job, Scola and Nina go undercover as a married couple deep in the diamond game as the team tries to find out who is responsible. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2024-04-16

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Family Affair
tntwest.us.description: After an FDIC security guard is killed while tending to a pregnant woman in distress, the team works to locate the woman and the killer who took her hostage; OA and Isobel worry about Maggie as she navigates taking care of Ella. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2024-04-23

tntwest.us.title: FBI - No One Left Behind
tntwest.us.description: The team is thrown into a highly political case after four members of the Taliban are shot and one is kidnapped in New York with no record of their entrance into the country; OA struggles to open up to Gemma about his past in Afghanistan. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2024-05-07

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Consequences
tntwest.us.description: When a truck driver is murdered and the drug he was transporting goes missing, the team hunts for those behind the remaining batch that is already wreaking havoc on the streets of New York. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2024-05-14

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Ring of Fire
tntwest.us.description: The Somalian terrorist group behind the death of Agent Hobbs resurfaces, sending the team on a chase to take them down for good. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2024-05-21

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Abandoned
tntwest.us.description: The assassination of a seemingly ordinary Brooklyn plumber launches the team into a globe-spanning investigation that ruffles feathers with the CIA; Tiffany struggles with fieldwork in the aftermath of the Hakim case. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2024-10-15

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Trusted
tntwest.us.description: The team is on the case when a suburban couple is murdered; all forensic evidence points to the home's previous owner, who is currently serving 10 years in federal prison; OA reunites with an old military colleague; Scola welcomes a new partner. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2024-10-22

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Détente
tntwest.us.description: After a series of targeted bombings in Queens, the team fears a citywide gang war is imminent, until a tip from OA's old Army buddy, Clay, directs their attention to an unexpected and powerful foe; Scola continues to struggle to find a new partner. arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E08 The Second Black President Episode Kevin is torn between running a clean campaign for class president and being negative about his opponent.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E31 The Kevin Gets a Commercial Episode Kevin auditions for a commercial for the mall burger joint and ends up being replaced by a famous kid actor that looks just like him.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E46 The Black Friday Episode Comical chaos ensues when the gang waits in line to shop at a department store on Black Friday. Kevin anticipates buying a new video game, Lindsey meets a boy, relationship problems plague Martin and Terrence hopes to buy toys for charity.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E12 The Parent Teacher Trap Episode When Suzanne gets roped into a committee at Kevin's school, where the other mums are mean to her, Nick volunteers to fill in on her behalf, making things awkward when the ladies love him.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E09 The She Got Game Night Episode When the Kingston-Persons decide to have a game night, all bets are off, as unlikely friends are drawn to one another when paired together for games.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E33 The Mother's Day Episode Nick tricks Suzanne and Marilyn into spending a weekend together at a spa for Mother's Day, where it becomes clear it will take more than a masseuse to relieve the tension in the women's relationship.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E02 The Credit Check Episode Nick needs a new van for work, but Suzanne worries they are already too much in debt and cannot afford to buy a new one; Suzanne has some credit issues she has not revealed to Nick.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E03 The Oh No She Di-in't Episode When Nick's new field producer, Sam, turns out to be female, Suzanne is convinced she is trying to steal her man, a suggestion Nick thinks is absurd until Sam actually makes a move on him.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E53 The Good Day Seattle Episode The station launches a new morning show, but Nick's cohost is a self-serving reality star; Marilyn moves in with the family.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E08 The Michelle Obama Sweater Episode Using her mother's credit card, Lindsey gets help from Nick in ordering a Michelle Obama sweater online; Kevin pretends to be sick to pull off a scam to get a signed A-Rod jersey.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E12 The Tiger Dad Episode Nick becomes a more influential parent, so he pushes Kevin and Lindsey hard, and they become model children.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E28 The Nick Hosts a Telethon Episode Despite warnings from other co-workers, Nick gets stuck hosting a charity telethon; Suzanne has to deal with a rich client's boring wedding plans.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E10 The Despicable E Episode Lindsey's romantic attentions turn to a young celebrity DJ, who only neglects her in return; Suzanne teaches Kevin the art of doing laundry.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E06 The Booty Episode Nick goes to watch a game with friends at a sports bar known to have sexy female waitresses; the kids want a larger allowance, but they're not willing to do more chores.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E15 The First .45 Episode When Lindsay tries to turn family members into stars of a reality television show, Kevin makes a discovery that brings too much reality to the Kingston-Persons household.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E04 The Soccer Episode Kevin is a big football fan, but Nick does not understand the appeal; Suzanne is frustrated by Lindsey's lack of communication and creates a fake Facebook account to learn what is going on.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E35 The Life Insurance Episode Although Nick and Suzanne realize that life insurance would be a good decision to protect their family, Nick has reservations about buying a policy.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E07 The Viral Video Episode Suzanne gets caught dancing on a video that soon becomes a huge viral hit; Marilyn decides Lindsey needs to learn how to cook soul food.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E36 The Hypertension Episode When Nick gets a doctor's report that he has high blood pressure, Suzanne does everything she can to make sure his stress levels stay low.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E25 The Mr. Almost Episode When Nick happens upon an old college pal, the unexpected meeting gives rise to a business plan that involves a sports star and an energy drink; the results are not so bubbly.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E28 The Liar, Liar Episode Suzanne begins to force everyone in the family to tell the truth at all times after she catches Nick in a lie.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E34 The Secret Episode Lindsey has a new crush and Gigi has a new boyfriend, but when certain secrets cannot be kept, a web of misinformation nearly ruins both situations.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E17 The Lemon Squeeze Episode When the family's morning routine devolves into fighting, Gigi suggests that they try an old sorority exercise called the Lemon Squeeze in order to turn their problems around.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E31 The Kwandanegaba Children's Fund Episode Nick wants Lindsey and Kevin to give back to the community, so they select a charity they find online; when the charity keeps asking for more money, Nick has to get to the bottom of it.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E21 The V.I.P. Tickets Episode Suzanne is furious when Nick invites Martin and not her to a baseball game; Kevin and Lindsey try to win tickets to Rihanna's Los Angeles concert.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E01 The Staycation Episode When Nick messes up Suzanne's plans for spring break, he turns the house into a makeshift resort, and promises to give the family the best vacation ever.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E23 The Compatibility Test Episode Suzanne meets a relationship adviser and becomes convinced that she and Nick are having compatibility issues.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E26 The Big Loan Episode Confusion ensues when Suzanne asks Marilyn for a loan in an attempt to keep her birthday present a secret for Nick.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E15 The Control Issue Episode When Nick points out that Suzanne has issues letting go of controlling everything, Suzanne lets everything go; the family realizes they need Suzanne's controlling ways to run a successful household.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E48 The Concussion Episode After a concussion, Nick is advised to not go to bed for a few hours; to avoid all risks, he attempts to stay up all night.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E19 The Disney Episode Nick is invited to play in a celebrity golf tournament at Walt Disney World; Suzanne has to miss the family's first vacation.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E04 The 22 Episode When the family oversleeps on the morning Lindsey is set to sing the National Anthem at a baseball game, it is all hands on deck just to make it to out of the house on time.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E30 The Silent Treatment Episode Nick and Suzanne stop talking to each other after Suzanne gets upset with Nick for his attempts to fix her problems without listening to her.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E02 The Thief Episode Nick refuses to give Lindsey money for a concert, so Lindsey resorts to stealing sixty dollars from Gigi's purse; when Gigi discovers the missing money, she blames Kevin for the theft.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E17 The Fall of Troy Episode When Troy provokes a school bully, Kevin strikes up a friendship with his tormentor to avoid a beat down; Kevin soon faces a difficult decision.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E10 The Get-Together Episode Nick notices the family is disconnected and proposes a get-together with friends and family so they have the opportunity to reconnect; Nick's planning leaves out some important details, leading to chaos.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E43 The Timeshare Episode Marilyn begins to date a younger man, but Nick doubts his true intentions. Meanwhile, Kevin breaks his arm.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E04 The Nick's Manny Pedi Episode When Suzanne crashes a night with Nick and his boys, Nick decides he needs to pay her back by showing up for spa treatments with Suzanne and her girlfriends to show her what it is like.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E27 The Family Portrait Episode Suzanne wants to have a formal portrait of the family taken, but trying to pull everyone together proves to be impossible.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E34 The Lindsey Goes Vegan Episode When Lindsey decides to adopt a vegan lifestyle, Suzanne convinces Nick they should go vegan as well; they come to regret this decision when they learn the extent of Lindsey's dedication.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E32 The Blockbuster Movie Episode Nick and Suzanne try to attend a highly anticipated movie premiere, but when their busy schedules get in the way, both are tempted to secretly go to the movie without the other.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E13 The Whose Card Is It Anyway Episode Suzanne and Nick go on a "People's Court TV" show when Nick lies about having spent a gift card Suzanne gave him, which she finds and spends on herself, calling him on his lie.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E27 The Lindsey Gets High Episode Lindsey freaks out when a friend offers her a drug; she gets a lesson on drugs from former child-star Todd Bridges who takes her on a wild ride.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Chef
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love. (Comedy drama) - 2014

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Prom Night
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond. (Horror, Thriller) - 1980

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Gang of Roses
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew. (Western, Action) - 2003

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A boy (Julian Dennison) and his foster father (Sam Neill) become the subjects of a manhunt after they get stranded in the New Zealand wilderness. (Comedy, Adventure) - 2016

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Are You Here
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After his eccentric pal (Zach Galifianakis) inherits a fortune from his estranged father, an aimless, womanizing weatherman (Owen Wilson) becomes involved in the legal battle initiated by his friend's sister (Amy Poehler). (Comedy drama) - 2013

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Blitz
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A tough cop (Jason Statham) goes after a serial killer who targets police officers. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action) - 2011

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Jack's Back
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn. (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama) - 1988

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Gerry
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Friends Gerry (Casey Affleck) and Gerry (Matt Damon) hike into Death Valley, but they stray so far from the trail that they have no idea how to get back. Initially, they maintain morale by rehashing old stories and reciting inside jokes, but the gravity of their situation sinks in as a return to civilization becomes more unlikely. As the sheer scope, hypnotic pull and spirit-crushing mirages of the desert affect the men, their will to live and sense of identity is challenged and transformed. (Drama) - 2002

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: 10th and Wolf
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them. (Drama) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: I'm Charlie Walker
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him. (Drama) - 2022

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Just Getting Started
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him. (Holiday, Comedy) - 2017

filmrisetruecrime.us.description: World's Most Evil Killers delves straight into the stories of the world's most prolific killers. Each episode focuses on one notorious killer and features first-hand accounts of their behavior; such killers range from Fred and Rose West, Ed Gein, the Clown Killer, to the Milwaukee Cannibal. Accounts are also given by detectives who ran the cases, journalists who reported on them, relatives, experts on analysis, and sometimes even survivors. (Documentary, Crime) - 2017-05-25

cinevault.us.title: Facing the Giants
cinevault.us.description: Grant Taylor, a Christian high-school football coach (Alex Kendrick), gets some very bad news. Besides his and his wife's (Shannen Fields) infertility problems, he faces the attempt of local parents to force the school to replace him. His team, the Shiloh Eagles, has never had a winning season in the six years that he has coached the boys. Following a visitor's message, Grant tries to inspire his team to use faith to conquer fear and opposing teams. (Action, Drama, Movie) - 2006-09-29

cinevault.us.title: The Deep
cinevault.us.description: Undersea adventure about a couple who become involved in a dangerous conflict with treasure hunters when they discover a deadly shipwreck in Bermudan waters. When they realize that the cache includes morphine, the pair enlist the help of an old treasure hunter to escape the drug dealers who hid their product amidst the sunken wreck. (Adventure, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 1977-06-17

cinevault.us.title: Darkness Falls
cinevault.us.description: In Maine, the residents of Darkness Falls are all aware of the legend of Matilda Dixon, an old woman who was tragically murdered by a mob in the 1800s because the townspeople thought she was killing children. Now Darkness Falls has to contend with Matilda's supernatural wrath. Childhood friends Kyle (Chaney Kley) and Caitlin (Emma Caulfield) return home to uncover the truth behind the legend after Caitlin's little brother (Lee Cormie) has recurring nightmares about Matilda. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2003-01-24

cinevault.us.title: Red Water
cinevault.us.description: Former oil rig worker John Sanders (Lou Diamond Phillips) became a Louisiana fishing captain after a tragic accident ended his career. In need of money, he agrees to help his ex-wife, Kelli (Kristy Swanson), whose company is having trouble extracting oil upriver. Meanwhile, thugs working for a Jamaican gangster head to the same bayou searching for $3 million buried underwater. Both the scientists and the criminals are menaced by a man-eating shark that can survive in fresh water. (Movie, Thriller) - 2003-08-17

cinevault.us.title: Maximum Risk
cinevault.us.description: French police officer Alain Moreau makes an astonishing discovery: Mikhail, a man who died recently in a breakneck car chase, is the twin brother he never knew. Alain then uncovers a web of family secrets that lead him to New York City, where his brother was involved with the Russian Mafia. Teaming up with Mikhail's lover, Alex Minetti, Alain must now assume his twin's identity and go undercover to avenge Mikhail's death. (Action, Movie) - 1996

cinevault.us.title: Sahara
cinevault.us.description: An Army sergeant (James Belushi), his crew (Mark Lee, Paul Empson) and stragglers try to hold off a Nazi battalion at a Libyan waterhole. (Movie, War) - 1995-04-25

cinevault.us.title: Felon
cinevault.us.description: A new convict (Stephen Dorff) struggles to maintain his sanity and sense of humanity after he's thrust into a prison system in which a brutal guard (Harold Perrineau) encourages gladiatorial combat between inmates. (Drama, Movie) - 2008-07-18

cinevault.us.title: The Take
cinevault.us.description: Deep in the slums of Los Angeles, good-natured Felix De La Pena (John Leguizamo), a family man and armored vehicle driver, is shot in the head during a hijacking attempt gone wrong. Though his wife, Marina (Rosie Perez), offers her love and support, Felix suffers from intense physical and emotional pain following the attack. As he begins to recover, he learns he has been framed for the stick-up; distraught, Felix decides to find the real culprit himself, despite his failing health and memory. (Action, Crime drama, Movie) - 2007

cinevault.us.title: U-Turn
cinevault.us.description: A two-bit criminal (Sean Penn) meets an attractive woman (Jennifer Lopez) and her spouse (Nick Nolte), each of whom wants him to murder the other. (Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 1997-08-27

cinevault.us.title: Money Train
cinevault.us.description: Charlie (Woody Harrelson) is a New York City transit cop with a mountain of gambling debts, and John (Wesley Snipes) is his responsible, and frequently exasperated, foster brother. They compete amicably for the affections of fellow officer Grace (Jennifer Lopez), but things become more serious when Charlie decides to rob the "money train" that carries the Transit Authority's daily proceeds. John must decide whether to prevent Charlie's crime or to join in on the heist. (Action, Movie) - 1995

crunchyroll.us.title: Danganronpa: The Animation

crunchyroll.us.title: Danganronpa: The Animation

crunchyroll.us.title: Danganronpa: The Animation
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E09 All All Apologies II Two of the main suspects for the fourth murder case are unsure of their own innocence; Naegi attempts to piece the clues together and figure out what actually happened.

crunchyroll.us.title: Danganronpa: The Animation
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E10 The Junk Food of Despair for Racing Through Youth: (Not) Normal Arc The group explores the fifth and final floor, which includes a botanical garden and classroom filled with blood; Kyouko is questioned on her identity, but insists she has no memory of it, due to her amnesia.

crunchyroll.us.title: Danganronpa: The Animation
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E11 The Junk Food of Despair for Racing Through Youth: Not Normal Arc Naegi and the others find themselves the unwilling participants in an awkward classroom trial; Monokuma seems to be plotting something.

crunchyroll.us.title: Danganronpa: The Animation

Naegi is now almost certain that the principal is not the mastermind, leaving him to question who it could be; he discovers the principal's digital notebook, filled with vital clues for the trial.

crunchyroll.us.title: Wonder Egg Priority

crunchyroll.us.title: Wonder Egg Priority
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E06 Punch Drunk Day The girls are attacked by a dangerous new type of enemy while trying to protect their Wonder Eggs; Acca and Ura-Acca may have a solution, but Ai is more concerned with the budding relationship between her mother and Mr. Sasaki.

crunchyroll.us.title: Wonder Egg Priority
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E07 After School at 14 It's Rika's birthday, and the girls get together to celebrate; Rika, however, is focused on her troubled relationship with her mother, and those worries carry over into her next battle.

crunchyroll.us.title: Wonder Egg Priority
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E08 The Happy Friendship Plan Acca and Ura-Acca would like to sell a Wonder Egg; they explain the Eggs and introduce four of their regular customers: Ai, Neiru, Rika, and Momoe.

crunchyroll.us.title: Wonder Egg Priority
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E09 A Story No One Knows The girls are surprised when Neiru invites them all to her house, and even more surprised to find out that she lives at her company.

crunchyroll.us.title: Wonder Egg Priority
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E10 Confession Ai, Rika and Neiru confront Acca and Ura-Acca, but they are distracted by shocking news from Momoe; later, Momoe faces her toughest battle yet while Ai makes a difficult decision.

crunchyroll.us.title: Wonder Egg Priority
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E11 An Adult Child The girls realize there's more waiting for them at the end of their missions; as doubts pile up and tensions rise, Ura-Acca decides to tell Ai his story.

crunchyroll.us.title: Wonder Egg Priority
crunchyroll.us.description: S01 E12 An Unvanquished Warrior Friendships are tested as Ai and Neiru realize how much victory has cost Rika and Momoe; Ai decides to fight again in spite of what she's learned, but the girl who emerges from her Egg this time may be more than she bargained for.

crunchyroll.us.title: Yuyu Hakusho

crunchyroll.us.title: Yuyu Hakusho
crunchyroll.us.description: S02 E13 Kurama's Stand It turns out that the fighters of Team Masho are the Shinobi of Spirit World, an ancient ninja faction. Thanks to Gama's curse, Kurama has to battle the Ice Master Touya without using his body or energy.

crunchyroll.us.title: Black Clover

crunchyroll.us.title: Black Clover

combatwarchannel.us.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E02 The Battle of Britain After the evacuation of troops from Dunkirk and the Fall of France, Britain stands alone against Germany in an aerial battle fought from July to October 1940.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Bomber: Terror of WWII
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E03 The Means to Victory The Blitz shook Britain, but the Allies struck back harder with strategic bombing; technology advanced-radar, gun turrets and bomb sights changed everything; civil defenses rose; after Pearl Harbor, the U.S. joined in, bringing more bombers.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Crimean War
combatwarchannel.us.description: The Valley of Death This program looks at the charge of the Light Brigade, when a misunderstood order sent troops straight into the main Russian artillery during the Battle of Balaclava; it also looks at the later Battle of Inkerman and the work of Florence Nightingale.

combatwarchannel.us.title: WWII In Color: From D-Day to Nazi Downfall
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E04 Monty's Gamble for Glory Germany's retreat continues as the Allies liberate France and Belgium; Montgomery's ambition to end the war risks more than his reputation as the push toward the Netherlands begins.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Night Swallows
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E08 Episode 8 The Messerschmitt hit by the pilots falls in the forest, but does not explode; both Germans and Soviet scouts hunt for a night vision device built into its control panel.

combatwarchannel.us.title: World War II: The Price of Empire
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E06 A Day in Infamy The Germans advance into Moscow; the Japanese occupy Southern Vietnam and Cambodia; the Japanese attack Pearl Harbor on Dec. 7, 1941.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Sword of Honour
combatwarchannel.us.description: Guy Crouchback joins the Army during World War II and deals with his manipulative ex-wife.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E01 Big Slim Big Slim is an aviation legend who was struck by shrapnel while in an air fight during WWII.

combatwarchannel.us.title: WWII: Capitulation
combatwarchannel.us.description: May 8, 1945, while the Allied troops parade through liberated towns to cheering crowds, the Second World War is in its final hours.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
combatwarchannel.us.description: S02 E09 The United Nations Line Is Stabilized While Truce Talks Continue The attack on Hill 1179.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E12 Take Command Reaching the heart of Hitler's Third Reich brought some of WWII's bloodiest battles.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Secrets of the Nazis
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E04 Hitler's Junkies In 1939, Germany's blitzkrieg was fueled by Pervitin-crystal meth; newly declassified files expose how Nazi leaders weaponized drugs to drive conquest and sustain power.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Reich Underground
combatwarchannel.us.description: Hitler pins his hopes of victory in World War II on a plan for vast and intricate underground weapons installations.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Night Swallows
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E07 Episode 7 Otto Link intends to take revenge on the Soviet pilots who thwarted his operation and destroyed a group of saboteurs.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Military Aircraft of the 20th Century: Fighter Aircraft: WWI
combatwarchannel.us.description: An encyclopedic look at aircrafts used by any military force in the 20th century; discussing the fighters of WWI, like the Nieuport 17, Albatross, Sopwith Camel, Fokker and more.

combatwarchannel.us.title: David Jason's Secret Service
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E01 The Story of Britain's Rich Spy History Sir David Jason looks into the origins of the British Secret Service.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Attackers
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E06 The captured Bes and one of the auxiliaries escape from the village and are then chased by the Germans.

combatwarchannel.us.title: First to Fight
